You will regularly spend time with the team in person, in Zurich and at our hubs, for team days, all-hands and offsites. These visits are financially supported by blp.Your MissionYou get customers live. Hands on, end to end, and fast.As a Senior Project Manager, you make large, global blp transformations happen. These programs touch finance, procurement and supply chain at once, run across multiple ERP systems and legal entities, and roll out country by country. Your job is to orchestrate all of it and get the customer live: the first go-live above all, because that is where credibility is won or lost, and then wave after wave with the same discipline. You run the steering committee, you lead a blp team on each engagement, and you do that across several engagements at once.At both levels, scope is the single biggest lever on whether a project goes live on time. On our largest strategic accounts a Client Partner carries the relationship and the commercial number, so your attention goes to delivery quality.We have done this many times, so you are not inventing the approach each time. A proven onboarding method and a strong toolkit are what let you carry your own customers from early on.Your Career Path in Project ManagementThis is the path most of our delivery leadership came through, and we hire at every step of it. Typically you bring 2+ years in consulting, implementation or project management.Senior Project Manager: You make large, global transformations happen: multiple ERPs, entities and countries, the steering committee, and a blp team on each engagement. Typically you bring 5+ years delivering complex, multi-country programs.Next steps: Lead a delivery team, or move into Consulting and from there towards our Client Partner role on strategic accounts.Moves into Consulting or Customer Success Engineering are open at every level, and many of our people make them.Key ResponsibilitiesRun implementations end to end: kick-off, scope, planning, configuration, testing and go-live.Manage several customers in parallel at different stages, and keep every one of them on date.Work with customers on their processes, and flag early where a process assumption will not hold.Coordinate the specialists on your projects: Integrations Engineers, Technical Project Managers and AI Automation Specialists.Own scope actively. Recognize a change request for what it is and handle it deliberately.Keep the project inside its budget, and raise it early when the effort is drifting.Hand over cleanly at go-live to our Consultants and support organization.In addition, as a Senior Project ManagerOwn the delivery outcome of global programs from kick-off to the last go-live: plan, scope, dependencies and date.Drive the first go-live relentlessly, then run wave planning across ERPs, entities and countries.Run the steering committee and own the decisions that come out of it.Write and execute the recovery plan when a program is off track.Lead the blp team on each engagement and coach the Project Managers working on your programs.What We're Really Looking ForThe following key attributes ensure success in this role:Scope Discipline – You notice when a project is quietly growing, and you raise it rather than absorbing it.Ownership & Autonomy – You take initiative, move things forward, and deliver end to end without being chased.Escalation Judgment – You escalate early, to the right person, with a proposal rather than a problem.Client Confidence – You are comfortable running a meeting with a customer's finance or IT lead in it.Four-Language Fluency – Technology, process, data and people. You speak each well enough to spot where a roadblock really sits.Structured Under Pressure – When a project goes sideways you get sharper and more organized, not louder.What You Bring5+ years of experience delivering complex projects: management consulting, enterprise software implementation, or large-scale transformation delivery.Proven track record running multi-country or multi-entity programs with senior client stakeholders, and steering a committee that includes client executives.Experience leading a delivery team rather than only a plan.Strong analytical and communication skills. Finance at reev is not a support function. It is a lever. The person in this role is the CEO's closest counterpart on how the business works - analytically, commercially, and financially. You own the foundation that makes fast, confident decisions possible. You are joining our finance team and helping establish AI-first operations built to work at scale.
You own Finance end-to-end: Accounting, Controlling, FP&A, M&A, and the systems that make all of it faster and smarter. You report directly to the CEO and act as a strong counterpart to him. Tasks

Own the operating model. Build an AI-first finance team that is faster, smarter, leaner.
Automate Finance. Monthly closing in half the time.
Control the right numbers. Burn Multiple, NRR, gross margin per product domain. You know which metrics drive the business and how to influence them positively.

Manage energy finance. reev's electricity tariff brings its own complexity. Procurement risk, hedging, margin per kWh, working capital, and regulatory exposure. A distinct block, not a footnote.
Build investor readiness. Own the financial model, equity story, and data room. Ensure reev is always ready - with the numbers and the narrative to back it up.
Drive M&A and consolidation. Our market is consolidating and we intend to lead it. You watch the market continuously, build and own the target pipeline, run valuation, business case, due diligence and negotiation, and land the integration afterwards - buying into new markets and strategic business fields is a core engine of our growth, not an opportunistic side bet.

AI as a tool for efficiency, not a talking point. You have built processes with AI and hold yourself accountable for the outcome.

An entrepreneurial mindset. You don't wait to be told where the problem is. You see around corners, connect the dots between Finance and the business model, and push the company forward - not just report on it.
Numbers into decisions. You work with the metrics that matter, not just the ones that are easy to report.

Strong Accounting and FP&A foundation. You lead across both disciplines, not just one.

Experience with energy or hardware-adjacent business models. Tariff economics, working capital through prepayments, regulatory exposure.

description_clean:

Wir sind ein wachsendes PropTech-Startup aus Münster. Unsere KI-gestützte Software ist die Entscheidungsgrundlage für die Immobilienentwicklung. Projektentwickler, Bestandshalter, Banken und Makler nutzen syte, um in Sekunden zu entscheiden, ob, was und wo gebaut, saniert oder gekauft wird. Ausgezeichnet wurden wir mit dem Deutschen KI-Preis 2023 und dem PropTech of the Year Award 2025 des ZIA (Zentraler Immobilien Ausschuss). Heute bildet unsere Plattform auf Basis von über 300 Terabyte Geodaten digitale Zwillinge für 62 Millionen Gebäude und Grundstücke in Deutschland ab.
Für den nächsten Sprung, von unseren heutigen Gebäudemodellen zum texturierten LoD3-Gebäude, suchen wir dich zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt als Senior Computer Vision / Photogrammetry Engineer (m/w/d) in Münster oder deutschlandweit remote.
Deine Aufgaben:

Alle Quellen in einem Modell vereinen: Du kombinierst 2D-Katasterdaten, LiDAR-Punktwolken, Schrägluftbilder, Nadir-Satellitenbilder und weitere Quellen zur genauestmöglichen Abbildung der realen Welt.
Unsere 3D-Modelle verbessern: Du bringst Bilddaten und moderne 3D-Rekonstruktionsverfahren in das Produkt, von Multi-View Stereo bis zu Methoden wie Gaussian Splatting und verbesserst damit unsere Gebäudemodelle erheblich.
Texturiertes LoD3 erreichen: Du texturierst unsere Modelle aus Schrägluftbildern und erkennst Fenster, Türen und Fassadenelemente. Diese projizierst du konsistent auf die richtige Fläche des richtigen Gebäudes, damit Geschossflächen, Nutzflächen und Oberflächen deutlich präziser berechnet werden können.
Mehr aus den Bildern herausholen: Du implementierst Methoden wie Multi-Image Super-Resolution und Occlusion-Aware Reconstruction. So überwindest du begrenzte Bildauflösung und Verdeckungen durch Bäume und andere Objekte.
Forschung in die Produktion bringen: Gemeinsam mit unseren Data Engineers, die Pipelines und Plattform verantworten, skalierst du Methoden von einer Handvoll Gebäude auf Millionen.
AI-native entwickeln: Du nutzt das volle Potenzial moderner AI-Coding-Tools wie Claude Code und Copilot und identifizierst proaktiv neue KI-Use-Cases im Kontext von Computer Vision und 3D-Rekonstruktion.

Ausbildung: Masterabschluss in einem technischen Fach (z. B. Informatik, Geoinformationssysteme, Geoinformatik, Physik, Mathematik).

Computer Vision: Starker Hintergrund in geometrischer und 3D-Computer-Vision: Structure-from-Motion, Dense Multi-View Stereo und Punktwolkenverarbeitung. Praktische Erfahrung darin, aus Punktwolken und Bildern Gebäudemodelle zu erzeugen.
Tech-Stack: Sicherer Umgang mit Python, insbesondere mit den relevanten Bibliotheken (NumPy, SciPy, PDAL, GDAL, OGR etc.).
Zusammenarbeit: Du arbeitest gern im Team und hast Erfahrung mit Versionsverwaltung (Git).
Interesse an der Domäne: Du hast Lust, in den anspruchsvollen PropTech-Bereich einzutauchen. Erfahrung in PropTech, Architektur oder Immobilienwirtschaft ist ein Plus.
Lernbereitschaft: Du willst in einem schnell wachsenden Startup schnell wachsen, echten Impact haben und technologisch vorne bleiben, besonders bei Cloud-Technologien und KI.
Sprache: Du sprichst fließend Englisch (mind. C1 Niveau).

Cherry on top

Erfahrung mit Cloud-Technologien, idealerweise Google Cloud Platform.
Deutsche Sprachkenntnisse sind ein Plus

Principal Backend Engineer
UK Remote
We're looking for an exceptional Principal Backend Engineer to help make backend engineering across SchemeServe better.
You'll be one of the most technically experienced engineers in the organisation and the CTO's primary technical partner for backend engineering, helping shape our architecture, engineering principles and technical direction.
But this isn't primarily a feature delivery role and your job isn't to personally build everything you help design.
Your real job is to make our engineering organisation better at building great software.
You'll work alongside engineers and teams, helping solve difficult problems, challenging their thinking and developing their technical skills and judgement.
What We Mean By Principal
This is a deeply technical role.
You'll need the depth to understand complex backend systems, architecture, security, performance, resilience and maintainability; review designs and implementations; spot risks; and challenge experienced engineers.
But technical knowledge alone isn't enough.
We want someone who understands there isn't always one "correct" way to build software.
Patterns, standards and best practices are useful tools. They aren't commandments.
We care about finding the most appropriate solution to the problem in front of us.
That means understanding the problem, business, existing platform, risks and likely future – and making pragmatic decisions based on the trade-offs.
Sometimes the right answer will be a new service or technology.
Sometimes it'll be improving what we already have.
Sometimes the boring solution really is the best solution.
We're quite comfortable with that.
How You'll Lead
Success in this role comes through influence rather than authority.
We don't want every difficult technical decision to end with:
"We'd better ask the Principal Engineer."
If an engineer proposes an approach you disagree with, we don't just want you to replace it with your own.
Understand their thinking. Ask questions. Challenge assumptions. Explore the trade-offs. Share your experience.
And be prepared to change your own mind too.
The goal is to leave that engineer better equipped to solve the next problem, not just holding the answer to this one.
Your technical impact should multiply through the people around you.
You'll remain close enough to the code to understand what's actually happening and occasionally roll up your sleeves to prototype, investigate a difficult problem or unblock a team.
But if after a year you've personally written loads of brilliant software while everyone around you is working exactly as they were before, we haven't succeeded.

Our platform has been evolving for more than 25 years.
At its heart is a mature C# .NET Framework 4.7 monolith, alongside an expanding ecosystem of modern C# .NET 10 and TypeScript services.
Our backend estate includes:

.NET Framework and modern C#/.NET.
TypeScript services.
Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL and Redis.
Azure cloud infrastructure.
Cloudflare platform services.
API-first architecture.
Git-based development workflows.

We're continuing to modernise, but we're not interested in modernisation for modernisation's sake.
We aren't trying to win an award for having the most fashionable architecture diagram.
We want a secure, reliable and maintainable platform that can support SchemeServe for many years to come – and we want you to help us decide what should evolve and, just as importantly, what doesn't need changing.
What You'll Do

Shape our backend engineering strategy, architecture and technical direction.
Help engineers make better technical and architectural decisions.
Develop sensible engineering principles and guardrails without replacing good judgement with rules.
Guide the continued evolution of our monolith and modern service-based platform.
Coach and mentor engineers, developing their technical skills and judgement.
Review significant designs and architectural decisions and challenge unnecessary complexity.
Champion security, quality, testing, observability, resilience and performance.
Identify technical risks and help teams navigate them.
Evaluate technologies and patterns based on their value to SchemeServe rather than their popularity elsewhere.
Balance long-term engineering quality with short-term business needs.
Occasionally contribute directly to implementation when that's genuinely the best way to help.
Be a generally awesome person.

What We're Looking For
You'll need:

Deep expertise in modern backend engineering and strong commercial C#/.NET experience.
Strong knowledge of software architecture, distributed systems and API design.
Experience with mature legacy applications and modern service-oriented architectures.
Strong cloud architecture experience, ideally Azure.
Excellent understanding of databases, security, testing, maintainability and modern software delivery.
Experience shaping engineering principles and practices across teams.
A track record of making engineers around you better through mentoring, coaching and technical leadership.
The ability to challenge experienced engineers constructively without becoming a gatekeeper.
Strong opinions, loosely held – the confidence to challenge and the humility to change your mind.
Excellent communication and the ability to influence without relying on authority.
Excellent technical judgement, balancing quality, complexity, risk, cost and business value.

Most importantly, we're looking for someone who asks:
"What's the right solution for us?"
rather than:
"What's the way everyone else is doing it?"
Nice To Have

Experience modernising large monolithic applications.
Commercial TypeScript backend experience.
Cloudflare or edge technology experience.
SaaS platforms at scale.
Financial services, insurance or another regulated industry.
Observability, platform engineering or SRE experience.
AI-assisted development and engineering productivity tooling.

You don't need to tick every box.
If you've got the technical depth, judgement and ability to make engineers around you better, we'd rather have a conversation than lose a great candidate because you haven't used one particular technology.
What Success Looks Like
Within your first year:

Engineers are making stronger technical and architectural decisions with greater confidence.
Our engineering principles are understood rather than blindly followed.
Technical discussions are constructive, pragmatic and result in clear decisions.
Security, reliability, maintainability and performance concerns are identified earlier.
We've made sensible progress modernising our platform without adding complexity for complexity's sake.
You've made a lasting positive impact on both our software and the people who build it.

Ultimately, we don't want SchemeServe to become dependent on you for every difficult technical decision.
We want SchemeServe to become better at making those decisions because you're here.

Une école d’excellence où chacun a l’opportunité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain.Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France et reconnue mondialement, notre école, membre de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, forme les talents de demain tout en contribuant activement à relever les grands défis industriels, numériques et environnementaux. Avec nous, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 collaborateurs, 2500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : conjuguer excellence académique, recherche d’avant-garde et impact sociétal positif.L’Institut Mines-Télécom fédère les grandes écoles françaises autour des défis industriels majeurs, numériques, énergétiques et écologiques. Avec ses 8 Grandes Écoles publiques et 2 écoles filiales, il est le premier institut public dédié aux ingénieurs et managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable, en formant les acteurs qui façonneront les transitions de demain.À Mines Saint-Étienne, nos centres de recherche sont le cœur battant de notre École.Pensés comme de véritables hubs d’innovation, nos cinq Centres de Formation et de Recherche articulent leurs expertises autour de grands enjeux industriels, environnementaux, sociétaux et technologiques.Leur mission ? Imaginer le monde de demain en alliant excellence académique et impact concret.Quand la technologie rencontre la médecine, ça donne… le Centre Ingénierie Santé (CIS) !Des dispositifs médicaux innovants (biomécanique, biomatériaux, nanoparticules) aux jumeaux numériques du patient et de l’hôpital, le CIS développe des solutions sur mesure pour répondre aux enjeux actuels de la santé.🧠 Modélisation, simulation, intelligence collective : nos enseignants-chercheurs travaillent main dans la main avec médecins, industriels et institutions.💙 Une seule ambition : améliorer le soin et la vie des personnes grâce à la science.🎯 Ce que nous attendons de vousAu sein du Centre Ingénierie et Santé et du MedTechLab, vous contribuez au déploiement d’une stratégie technico-réglementaire permettant de sécuriser le développement, l’expérimentation, l’évaluation et, le cas échéant, la mise sur le marché de produits et services innovants en santé, notamment de dispositifs médicaux et de solutions de santé numérique.Le MedTechLab®, cofondé par Mines Saint-Étienne, AÉSIO Santé et AÉSIO Mutuelle, est un espace d’open innovation dédié à la co-création, la modélisation, le test et l’expérimentation d’innovations pour la santé et l’autonomie. Lauréat de l’appel à projets Tiers Lieux d’Expérimentation de France 2030, il accompagne industriels, start-up et acteurs sanitaires et médico-sociaux dans des études d’usage, études cliniques, analyses médico-économiques, études de marché et démarches allant jusqu’au développement de produits minimum viables.Vous intervenez en appui des équipes du MedTechLab et du CIS, en lien avec les partenaires académiques, hospitaliers et industriels. Vous accompagnez les projets sur leurs différentes étapes : R&D, stratégie réglementaire, recherche clinique, gestion des risques, constitution et maintenance de la documentation technique, marquage CE et suivi post-marquage.Objectif du poste : garantir la prise en compte des exigences réglementaires et qualité applicables aux projets du MedTechLab et développer une culture partagée des affaires réglementaires au sein de l’écosystème.Vos missions principales :• Contrôler la conformité des activités et des processus au regard des référentiels applicables et contribuer à la création et à l’évolution de la documentation des systèmes et outils qualité.• Dans le cadre du projet PREMYOM, accompagner le comité d’éthique interne du consortium en lien avec les DPO des différents partenaires.• Identifier les normes et réglementations applicables aux projets de recherche et d’innovation du MedTechLab, assurer une veille réglementaire et normative et coordonner cette veille avec les partenaires.• Accompagner la mise en œuvre des normes ISO 14155, ISO 13485 et ISO 14971, notamment pour les études cliniques, les systèmes de management de la qualité et l’analyse des risques.• Accompagner les équipes dans la conformité des recherches cliniques et apporter un appui méthodologique et technique.• Contribuer aux stratégies de marquage CE : supervision et rédaction des dossiers techniques, déclarations de mise sur le marché, maintien de la documentation de conformité et suivi post-marquage.• Piloter l’évaluation réglementaire des changements, gérer la liste des normes appliquées aux projets et traiter les questions réglementaires et techniques des autorités de santé à la suite des dépôts de dossiers.• Dans le cadre du RGPD, veiller, en lien avec les DPO de Mines Saint-Étienne et d’AÉSIO Santé, à la conformité des projets et au respect des procédures.• Préparer et animer les réunions qualité / affaires réglementaires, contribuer aux comités de pilotage, suivre les indicateurs, élaborer des tableaux de bord et communiquer sur la démarche d’amélioration continue.• Participer aux réseaux professionnels et entretenir les relations utiles avec les autorités et organismes compétents (ANSM, ANS, CNIL, CPP, CNAM, etc.).• Définir les stratégies réglementaires des produits (classification, voie de mise sur le marché, marchés cibles : UE, France, puis international)• Assurer la veille sur les évolutions normatives et réglementaires (MDR 2017/745, IVDR 2017/746, AI Act, RGPD, cybersécurité, données de santé) et en mesurer l'impact• Anticiper les exigences liées aux innovations (logiciels dispositifs médicaux, IA, objets connectés, etc.)• Gérer les échanges avec les organismes notifiés• Sensibiliser et former les équipes internes aux enjeux réglementaires  🔍 Ce que nous recherchonsVous êtes titulaire d’une formation supérieure dans le domaine des affaires réglementaires, de la qualité ou du droit de la santé :• Licence professionnelle, Master 1 ou Master 2 en affaires réglementaires, droit de la santé, qualité appliquée aux produits de santé ou formation équivalente sont privilégié. Également une première expérience en affaires réglementaires dans le secteur de la santé (dispositifs médicaux, e-santé ou médicament). Profils juniors motivés à étudier selon le contexte. Connaissances recherchées :• Réglementation des dispositifs médicaux et référentiels associés, notamment règlement (UE) 2017/745 (MDR), ISO 13485, ISO 14155 et ISO 14971.• Réglementation des recherches cliniques, bonnes pratiques cliniques, RGPD, procédures de recherche clinique, cycle de développement d’un projet innovant en santé, vocabulaire médical et scientifique. Compétences attendues :• Capacité à identifier et interpréter les exigences réglementaires et normatives applicables à un projet, et à les traduire en actions opérationnelles.• Maîtrise des méthodes d’analyse des risques, de résolution de problèmes et de gestion documentaire ; capacité à contribuer à des dossiers techniques et de marquage CE.• Capacité à conduire des projets transversaux, à argumenter des solutions en assurance qualité / affaires réglementaires et à travailler avec des interlocuteurs académiques, cliniques, industriels et institutionnels.• Maîtrise des outils bureautiques et capacité à élaborer des outils de suivi, indicateurs et tableaux de bord.• Anglais scientifique écrit ; capacité à échanger en anglais dans un contexte professionnel appréciée.Qualités personnelles :• Autonomie, rigueur, organisation, sens des priorités, polyvalence et capacité d’adaptation ; respect du secret professionnel, de l’éthique et de la réglementation en vigueur.• Curiosité pour l'innovation et capacité à trouver des solutions conformes• Aisance relationnelle, sens du travail en équipe et capacité à communiquer avec des partenaires variés. Des déplacements ponctuels en France sont à prévoir selon les projets.Relations professionnelles : médecins investigateurs, TEC, chefs de projets de recherche clinique, biostatisticiens, data-managers, équipes du MedTechLab et du CIS, partenaires AÉSIO, structures de recherche clinique et technologique, start-up et industriels, ainsi que les instances administratives et réglementaires compétentes.🌍 Pourquoi rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne ?Nous accompagnons chacun de nos collaborateurs sur le chemin de l’excellence, avec la conviction qu’ensemble, nous pouvons avoir un impact durable et significatif sur notre monde.Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est l’opportunité de trouver :· Un environnement stimulant : des moyens expérimentaux de pointe, un réseau international solide (T.I.M.E., EULIST) et des campus à taille humaine avec un environnement urbain· Un impact réel : des projets de recherche contractuelle à hauteur de 11 M€/an, majoritairement avec des partenaires industriels, un centre de culture scientifique la Rotonde qui s’engage depuis 25 ans dans la médiation des sciences avec plus de 50 000 visiteurs/an· Une qualité de vie incomparable : 49 jours de congés et RTT, télétravail partiel, prise en charge des transports en commun à 75 %, soutien financier au covoiturage et au vélo et un baromètre social où 83 % des collaborateurs plébiscitent la qualité de vie au travail.Construisons un avenir plus durable, à travers la science, l’ingénierie, et des projets qui font sens.📩 Candidatez dès maintenant !Date limite de candidature : 15/10/2026🔗 title: Senior DevSecOps Engineer
description_clean:
Our Security and IT team keeps the 360Learning platform secure, compliant and auditable for the 1,500 organisations that learn on it every day. As a Senior DevSecOps Engineer, your mission is to make our infrastructure secure by design, detectable by default, and provable at audit time.
360Learning runs its learning platform on Azure and Kubernetes, certified ISO 27001:2022 and SOC 2 Type II. Over the past two years the technical security workload has grown on every front: a larger and more regulated customer base sending their own scans and security assessments, a wider detection and response scope, more infrastructure to keep hardened and auditable, and a growing backlog of security engineering projects that never reach the top of the queue.
We are creating this position to add real technical capacity on the infrastructure side of security, and to move part of our security posture from manual effort to automated guardrails. You will be the bridge between security and platform engineering: deep enough in infrastructure to fix things yourself, and close enough to security operations to know what to look for.
“Ours is a small, senior team with a broad scope: information security, compliance, infrastructure governance and internal tooling, with dual audit accountability on ISO 27001:2022 and SOC 2 Type II. That means direct impact and no layers between you and the decision. Roughly half of this role is greenfield build work you will own end to end.” Guillaume Seigneuret, CISO and Hiring Coach.
Within 1 month, you will:


Complete our onboarding and learn how we work through our own platform and our Convexity culture


Map our Azure and AKS environment, our detection and logging coverage, and our ISO 27001 and SOC 2 control scope with the CISO and the Security Engineer


Meet the DevOps, platform engineering and IT teams you will work with daily


Shadow alert triage and one customer security assessment end to end


Within 3 months, you will:


Be autonomous on our AKS and Azure environment and handle infrastructure related alerts end to end


Have shipped at least one concrete hardening or automation improvement in production


Own the infrastructure scope of vulnerability management, from triage to remediation follow up


Within 6 months, you will:


Have the honeypot live and producing high fidelity alerts


Have measurably widened SIEM connector coverage, with documented log sources and retention


Run infrastructure vulnerability remediation on a predictable cycle with SLA reporting


Within 12 months, you will:


Manage detection content as code, with reviewed and tested rules and documented runbooks


Have largely automated audit evidence on the infrastructure scope


Have eliminated long lived credentials on the critical paths, so engineering teams ship on secure defaults they did not have to think about


The Skill Set:


5+ years in infrastructure, cloud or platform engineering with a strong security focus, or in security engineering with hands on infrastructure practice


Production experience with Kubernetes: RBAC, network policies, admission controllers, secrets handling, workload identity, runtime security


Solid cloud experience, ideally Azure. Strong AWS or Google Cloud experience with a genuine interest in converting works too


Infrastructure as code: Terraform, GitOps workflows, CI/CD pipelines


Scripting and automation: Python or Go, plus shell. Comfortable reading and writing code, and opening pull requests on repositories owned by other teams


Log analysis and investigation: cloud audit logs, query languages, correlation across identity, network and application sources


Fluent English (US/UK) / B2 level or equivalent (FR). 


Enthusiasm for our working environment explained here: https://bit.ly/Convexity360L


What we offer:


Compensation: Package includes base salary, a variable component and equity 📈


Benefits/Perks: Work From Home stipend, RTT, lunch vouchers, medical insurance, gym subscription, 1 month parental leave for the second parent. 


Balance: Flexible hours, full remote work possible anywhere in France 🏠


Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion: We have 6 active ERGs including Mental Health, Environmental/Sustainability, Women, Parents, LGBTQIA2S+, and Ethnic Diversity. Each group has at least one executive team member serving as a member of the group, bringing greater awareness to each group’s activities and providing a quick path to impact 🤝


Corporate Social Responsibility: Review our CSR Charter: 360learning.com/blog/corporate-social-responsibility-charter 🌎🌏🌍


Culture: A framework that will help you make an impact - envision our way of working and our Convexity Culture: https://bit.ly/Convexity360L & find out more about the teams, product and processes https://bit.ly/42H1ggC 🚀👩🏻‍💻🏆


Interview Process:
Phone Screen with our Talent Acquisition Manager
Discovery Meeting with our Head of Security
Live exercise with our Head of Security and our Head of Devops: investigation of an incident scenario, or review of an insecure infrastructure configuration
Clarification Meeting with the Security Engineer and a DevOps engineer
Culture Fit Meeting with our VP of Engineering

Fähigkeit zur strukturierten Problemanalyse und -lösung.
Erfahrung im Projektmanagement und in der Umsetzung von IT-Projekten.

Kundenorientierung und die Fähigkeit, technische Sachverhalte verständlich zu erklären.

Sinnstiftende Arbeit: Wir entwickeln innovative Therapien, die Menschen wirklich helfen

Bist du bereit, mit uns die Zukunft der Rehabilitation zu gestalten?

Du betreust unsere Unternehmens-IT und entwickelst bestehende Systeme und Strukturen gemeinsam mit dem Team weiter.
Netzwerk-, Server- und Cloud-Infrastrukturen administrierst du zuverlässig und unterstützt bei deren Optimierung.
Du setzt Maßnahmen im Bereich IT-Sicherheit und Cybersecurity um und wirkst an der Weiterentwicklung unserer Sicherheitsstandards mit.
Firewalls, VPNs und weitere Sicherheitslösungen werden von dir betreut und kontinuierlich überwacht.
Du analysierst digitale Geschäftsprozesse und unterstützt dabei, geeignete Automatisierungsmöglichkeiten zu identifizieren und umzusetzen.
Neue Technologien und IT-Lösungen prüfst du auf ihren Nutzen und begleitest deren Einführung.
Bei der Entwicklung interner Softwarelösungen und Automatisierungen bringst du deine technischen Ideen ein.

Du hast eine Ausbildung als Fachinformatiker*in, ein Studium im IT-Bereich oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation erfolgreich abgeschlossen.

Du kommunizierst sehr sicher auf Deutsch und verfügst über gute Englischkenntnisse.
Bei uns hast du die Chance, wirklich etwas zu bewegen und zu gestalten. Die „Grüne Wiese“ wartet auf deine Ideen und Initiative. Werde Teil unseres dynamischen Teams und gestalte die Zukunft der Med-Tech-Branche aktiv mit!

SPREAD builds engineering intelligence for the world's most complex products. Our AI-native platform gives automotive OEMs, defense primes, and industrial manufacturers a single source of product truth so engineering teams can make confident product decisions, fast. In this role, you sit inside the Founders' Office and work on the decisions that set SPREAD's direction. You own the strategy cycle and translate it into company goals and OKRs; you drive the strategic and improvement initiatives that come out of it, and you run the operating rhythm that keeps the leadership team deciding and the company executing. Alongside that, you own SPREAD's ecosystem of partners and senior industry advisors. You shape how the whole company hears about strategy through the monthly Assembly, and you build the material founders and the leadership team decide on. You report to the VP Strategy & Finance and work daily with the founders, the leadership team, and the people delivering the outcomes you help define.
Your Mission

Own the strategy cycle from analysis through to a written strategy the leadership team commits to, then translate it into company OKRs, goals, and the quarterly review rhythm that keeps every team measured against them.
Drive strategic and improvement initiatives end to end. Recent examples include improving our cross-functional delivery model, leveling up our performance management system, building out our competitor intelligence, and rolling AI agents out company-wide.
Run the operating rhythm of the leadership team across the weekly leadership meeting, monthly workshops, and half-year offsites. Set the agenda, prepare the discussions and decisions, and track every decision and task.
Own the monthly company Assembly, from storyline to deck, so every team leaves knowing where SPREAD stands, where we are going, and what it means for their work.
Build and steer SPREAD's partner ecosystem across hyperscalers, systems integrators, strategy consultancies, and tech companies, and convert those relationships into commercial opportunities, co-marketing and integrated offerings.
Manage SPREAD's portfolio of senior industry advisors, former executives from the automotive and defense industry, to generate commercial opportunities and capture deep industry insights and expertise.
Step into selected high-stakes commercial opportunities and ongoing engagements alongside Sales, Product, Value Realization, and Engineering, bringing structure and pace.
Prepare investor materials and board reporting across fundraising rounds and quarterly cycles.

Your Experience

4+ years in strategy consulting, investment banking, or an operating strategy role inside a scale-up, with end-to-end ownership of your own workstreams and direct exposure to the client side.
Deep understanding of the automotive and/or defense industry. You know how a vehicle or a defense platform moves from requirement to development to integration to testing to production to field service, and you can hold that conversation with a senior engineering leader.
Business-fluent German and English, because both appear in the same week across leadership meetings, partner negotiations, customer conversations, and investor material.
A strong analytical toolkit covering quantitative analysis and executive-level materials. You do the analysis, and you write the slide that makes it decision-ready.
Track record of driving decisions with executive stakeholders, including the judgment to know which questions belong in the room and which you resolve before the meeting starts.
Experience turning strategy into action, whether through OKRs, a goal cascade, or an operating rhythm you designed and ran yourself.
Commercial instinct for partnerships and customer opportunities. You are comfortable opening a relationship, holding a cadence, and being honest with yourself about which relationships produce outcomes and which absorb time.
AI-native working style. You use AI tools daily to scale your output across research, analysis, drafting, and workflow automation. SPREAD is an AI-first company, and every team member operates accordingly.
Based in Berlin or close enough for regular in-office collaboration.

Why SPREAD?

Work on the questions that decide where a company building engineering intelligence for the products that move the world goes next, with the founders and the leadership team as your direct counterparts.
Own initiatives end to end with full visibility across Product, Engineering, Sales, Finance, and the partner ecosystem, and see your work land in the company's direction and in decisions that actually get made.
Grow inside a high-talent-density environment with direct feedback and a leadership team that expects you to challenge it.
Attractive compensation, an annual learning budget, and workation options.
Deutschlandticket mobility budget and Urban Sports Club partnership.
30 vacation days and one paid volunteering day per year.

Join us as an Android Engineer and help us build the mobile experience that 600,000+ European businesses rely on every day to manage their finances. title: Senior Product Designer, Design Systems
description_clean: Who We Are Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 300+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, annual revenue now exceeds $100m USD and millions use our browser on on Mac, Windows, iOS, and Android, our search engine, and the DuckDuckGo subscription. We also offer private, useful, and optional AI, including Duck.ai, which lets you chat privately with ChatGPT, Claude, and other AIs, all in one place. You'll audit our existing system, lead projects that move it forward across platforms and products like Duck.ai and Search, as well as shape how we manage and scale it as we grow.  Applying your hands-on design skills, you will autonomously lead highly impactful projects that scale across millions of users, and collaborate with team members at all levels to pioneer new solutions as we build out the privacy layer for the internet. From ideation to execution, you'll assess vague problems, propose high-impact solutions, and execute them against a set of success criteria. You'll have a voice in all product-related design decisions, whether large or small, and an opportunity to work on a team dedicated to our ethical, privacy by design approach. title: Senior Robotics Software Engineer - Autonomy Architecture
description_clean:
Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots. 
Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment. 
Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry. 
The Gravis RACK is a machine-agnostic retrofit kit that adds autonomy to excavators and wheel loaders from 10 to 100+ tonnes: LiDAR and camera sensing, GNSS RTK, networking hardware and rugged edge compute that works offline. Paired with the Slate tablet and our Copilot software, it lets an operator run a machine manually, with AI assistance, or fully autonomously.  Increasingly, we also build custom hardware to adapt our machines for highly specialized, robust applications beyond traditional excavation. 
About the Job
The autonomy team at Gravis architects autonomous behaviors for different tasks, e.g. different types of excavation or truck loading. This role owns the architecture that lets those behaviors live in the same software stack as opposed to creating one SW stack per behavior. You'll be responsible for how tasks are decomposed and orchestrated, for the interfaces between, and for the software quality. We are looking for a senior roboticist with C++ and Python expertise and high standards for software quality, who can make clear, pragmatic architectural calls that let the system grow without losing stability.
What you'll do
Architecture


Own the task-level architecture shared across our autonomous behaviors


Define clear module boundaries and responsibilities between behavior orchestration, factor out common logic across different tasks




Implement component tests and telemetry/metrics collection pipelines




Identify technical debt early enough to guide the team toward sustainable solutions


Act as the go-to person for software quality: modern C++ practices, code structure, error handling, robustness. Likewise for Python.


Configuration & tooling


Design an easily extensible and testable module for deploying policies that can be reused across tasks and supports schema versioning for observations, so a deployed policy pins the exact version of the computations it was trained against


Provide technical leadership on C++ and Python tooling (clang-tidy, sanitizers, static analysis, linting, typing, test setup)


Work with our incoming simulation team to unify training, benchmarking and evaluation tooling across tasks, so adding a task doesn't mean forking tooling and infrastructure


What we're looking for
Required


Bachelor's or Master's degree in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field


5+ years developing complex C++ systems, with deep knowledge of modern C++ (17 and onwards)


Strong Python for tooling, configuration and simulation-side scripting


Strong experience designing large, modular software systems that outlived their first use case


High standards for software quality and long-term maintainability


Nice to have


Experience with behavior trees, state machines, or other task orchestration frameworks in production


Experience working alongside learned controllers in a production stack - deployment, versioning, observation pipelines. No need to train them.


Motion planning, geometric algorithms, or spatial data structures


Feature-flagged deployments, staged rollouts, or long-lived platforms


This role is a great fit if…


You want to make systems work reliably in the real world, and enjoy thinking through the edge cases


You'd rather our next behavior be a configuration than a dedicated piece of software


You want the best idea to win regardless of who had it, and you'd rather be corrected by the numbers than agreed with


You take a result end-to-end: when something needs to happen, you use or ask for whatever it takes, even outside your scope


You're a software purist, but pragmatic — first make it work, then make it right, and cut corners consciously when it's the right call

title: Internship - Studio Apelbaum - Art, Engineering or Communication (Berlin)
description_clean:
We are looking for interns in art, engineering, and communication to join Studio Apelbaum.
Studio Apelbaum, founded by artist and engineer Jonathan Apelbaum, combines traditional oil painting with interactive technology to create ‘Cognitive Paintings’ that shift images with light, movement, and sound through custom LED systems and software.
Our team includes engineers, musicians, performers, writers, designers, and builders. We are currently building a new 150 m² studio at Osloer Straße 16–17 in the historic Umspannwerk Christiania, with a workshop and our own exhibition space.
Our own series of invitation-only events and exhibitions is central to the new studio. Over the next few months, we will design and build adaptable furniture in steel and oak so the same room can host work, an exhibition, dinner, and an event.
The whole team is artists in their own way; they think differently and create their own methods.
We create the artworks, design the space, invite our guests, and welcome them. C’est le principe de l’œuvre complète / architecture verticale.
How the internship works
The internship is hands-on and involves working closely with the team across the studio: building, production, and exhibitions.
The first part of the internship will focus on building the new studio, including steel and oak furniture and the adaptable exhibition and dining space. You will then develop the Cognitive Paintings and assemble and test the paintings and their LED systems.
Over the six months, you will take on a main project based on your skills and interests, guided by the team. This could include engineering, programming, communication, music, design, documentation, filming, or any related field.
During the internship, you will gradually develop your own main project based on your skills and interests, in collaboration with Jonathan. This project can develop further and become one of your main areas of work within the studio.
You will also help prepare our major exhibition in May 2027, as well as installations and projects outside the studio with TRACEY (formerly Lunchbox Candy), Playground Festival, and other art festivals.
Tasks
Your tasks will include:

Co-building the new studio (steel and oak, as used in the paintings)
Co-building, assembling, and testing Cognitive Paintings and their LED systems
Organizing materials, tools, storage, artwork transport, and installations
Supporting the preparation and installation of exhibitions and events

Depending on your background, skills, and interests, whether in engineering, communication, curation, music, or another field, you will have the opportunity to develop a project that connects with your own passion.
This could include:

Contributing to research, prototypes, and software
Filming and documenting the studio
Designing the exhibition flyers, invitations, and catalog

As our founding-level security hire, you will establish the security engineering function, define its priorities and work directly with engineering teams to embed effective security controls throughout our technology environment.
As an AI Security Engineer, you would be responsible for:

Defining Clariness' security engineering strategy and roadmap, and building and operating the security function across application security, cloud security, AI and LLM security, vulnerability management and supporting security tooling.
Working directly with engineering teams on secure system design, threat modelling, penetration testing and vulnerability remediation, while embedding appropriate security controls into development processes and CI/CD pipelines.

Designing and validating safeguards for AI agents, including sandboxing, privilege and access controls, secure tool use and adversarial red teaming of AI systems.
Evaluating, deploying and continuously improving AI-powered security automation, including autonomous vulnerability triage, LLM-powered alert analysis, compliance evidence gathering and AI-assisted threat intelligence.
Assessing commercial and open-source security tools based on effectiveness, operational fit and cost, and developing custom solutions where existing tooling does not meet Clariness' requirements.
Managing Clariness' IT security compliance programme—including SOC 2 Type II, applicable EU AI Act high-risk obligations, GDPR Article 32 technical measures and GxP IT security controls—while maintaining audit-ready documentation and acting as the primary security liaison for external auditors, regulators, Legal and Compliance.

We would like you to have: 

At least five years of hands-on experience in security engineering, application security or information security, with strong technical depth beyond advisory or governance responsibilities.
Proven experience building or significantly developing a security programme within a product engineering environment, ideally as an early or founding security hire.
Strong practical experience across application security, cloud security, secure software development, threat modelling, penetration testing, vulnerability management and security controls within CI/CD pipelines.
Experience assessing, testing or implementing security controls for LLM-powered applications, RAG systems or agentic pipelines.
Hands-on experience with AI agents, either building them for security automation or securing them through adversarial testing, sandboxing and privilege controls.
Demonstrable compliance experience involving at least one SOC 2 audit cycle, GDPR programme ownership or implementation of EU AI Act requirements, including the ability to produce audit-ready documentation and work with external auditors.

Uns ist wichtig, dass sauber gearbeitet wird, Probleme wirklich gelöst werden und unsere Kunden ihr Fahrzeug mit einem guten Gefühl wieder abholen.Wir arbeiten an Fahrzeugen aller Marken und decken ein breites Spektrum ab: Inspektionen nach Herstellervorgaben, Diagnose, Bremsen, Motor, Fahrwerk, Klima, Getriebe, Umbauten und vieles mehr. Gerade deshalb ist der Alltag bei uns abwechslungsreich. Kein Tag ist genau wie der andere und wenn ein Fehler nicht sofort auf der Hand liegt, nehmen wir uns die Zeit, ihn wirklich zu finden.Unsere Werkstatt ist modern und sehr gut ausgestattet. Mehrere Hebebühnen, aktuelle Diagnosetechnik und alles, was man braucht, um ordentlich arbeiten zu können. Gleichzeitig legen wir viel Wert darauf, dass die Werkstatt sauber, gepflegt und ein angenehmer Arbeitsplatz ist. Schließlich verbringt man hier einen großen Teil seines Tages und soll sich auch wohlfühlen.Für unser Team suchen wir einen Kfz-Meister (m/w/d), der sein Handwerk versteht, gerne Verantwortung übernimmt und Lust auf ein Umfeld hat, in dem gute Arbeit geschätzt wird.Was wir dir bietenBei uns kannst du dein Wissen und deine Erfahrung wirklich einbringen. Das bedeutet bei uns: kurze Wege, direkte Gespräche und schnelle Entscheidungen. Our mission is simple: double the world’s capacity for care and strengthen the human connection at its heart.We found product-market fit with a freemium medical scribe that clinicians love. Now, we're expanding. Every task a clinician hands to Heidi is a patient who feels more attended to, a health system unclogged, and a clinician who gets to be a clinician again.We’ve grown annual recurring revenue from $1 million to $50 million in two years.To go further, we’ve secured US$340 million: a $100 million Series C led by Blackbird, with Phoenix Court, Point72 Private Investments and Headline, alongside a $240 million growth investment led by General Catalyst’s Customer Value Fund.If you want to join us in doing work worth shipping, jump in.The role Heidi sits in an unusual position. We lead a category being built for the first time. Hundreds of thousands of clinicians found us on their own, started using the product for free and told a colleague. The market is open and the clinicians in it already like the product. Your job is to turn those smaller scale use cases into enterprise deals.You're the first line to Heidi in DACH. Inbound demand connects you with practices, MVZs and hospital groups already using us, and you decide whether to qualify each one in, out or close it yourself. Where the signals run thin, you build the outbound. For most clinicians you'll be the first person from Heidi they ever speak to. You'll both triage inbound to your Account Executive where it belongs and close your own deals from day one, because we want people as close to the frontline as possible. You'll build a network across German-speaking healthcare that outlasts the role.What you’ll doWork the inbound queue and the warm product signals across DACH. Your day goes to clinicians and practices already using Heidi, where the product tells you who's outgrown the free version.Build outbound where the signals are thin: pick the practice groups, MVZs and hospital groups worth going after and work them in German.Research the accounts behind those signals, work out who else in the practice or hospital group needs to be in the conversation, and build the angle for each one.Reach the people the signals point to, across calls, email and social, while the interest is still fresh.Book demos and meetings for your AEs with enough context that nothing is lost in the handoff.Own small SMB deals end to end, from first conversation through to closed.Keep HubSpot accurate, keep the pipeline moving and hit your qualified-lead number every month.Partner with AEs, Marketing, Product, Operations and Customer Success so what you promise on the call matches what clinicians get, and so the German-language product and collateral keep up with what you hear.Track what's shifting in German healthcare (regulation, the practice groups, the insurers, the competitive set) and tell the team what you're hearing on the phones.What we're looking forNative or fluent German, and English that allows you to work in a global team. We care more about what you've achieved than any time in a sales role.You care about what we do. You'd rather learn how the product works than memorise a pitch.You can hold a conversation with anyone and get to the point of it fast. Clinicians have extremely busy schedules, you respect that and still get the meeting.Knowing how German healthcare buys (who decides in a Praxis, an MVZ or a hospital group, and who pays) is a head start. If you don't know it yet, you're the type who'd learn it in your first month.Organised and self-running. You run your own list, your own day and your own follow-ups without being chased.Passion for AI, shown through hands-on building, prototyping or side projects.You default to building over requesting.You're confident in your thinking and open to being wrong. Great ideas win regardless of who surfaces them. Attitude is more important than experience so if you are a hungry, competitive  and highly motivated operator who has a knack for problem solving and building relationships we want to hear from you.How we show upBuild for the next decade, not next quarter. Our targets are outrageous on purpose. The world's health doesn't have the luxury of incrementalism.Lead, don't wait. We treat tomorrow's problems today. Sometimes we build what's needed before it's wanted, and we're fine with that.Follow the evidence. Trust the patient. We pursue truth relentlessly. But when the subjective and objective disagree, we treat the patient, not the numbers. Ego is a comorbidity we can't afford.Own the outcome. Everyone here carries the company. Raise problems with solutions, solve them end-to-end, and never be a bystander.Ship, measure, go again. A button today, a workflow tomorrow. More iterations beat better planning. We're precise at pace, not reckless.Live in clinicians' reality. Not the ideal workflow, the twenty-patients-before-lunch actual one. We build for exhausted humans, and we'd better be decent ones while we do it.Why Heidi?You’ll join a team measured on real-world impact, not press cycles. We live and breathe the challenges of modern health systems, and are laser-focused on exacting the change we’d like to see. We’re medicos, engineers, builders and designers who’ve felt (on every side of the equation) what non-care feels like, the moral and practical toll as a provider or receiver.Building what we’re building isn’t always easy. Standard tech playbooks routinely fail in healthcare, and the friction of the medical system will test your perseverance. But we didn’t choose easy, we chose a purpose-driven mission that actually matters. We hold ourselves to a higher standard because healthcare demands it. If you join Heidi, you recognize that the deeper question isn’t whether AI can solve the global healthcare crisis, but whose hands will shape it.True A-players progress extremely fast here. The nature of the scale-up game is demanding, but we value sustainable performance and mental health. You're trusted to perform, and you set your schedule. We operate on outcomes > inputs, not process theatre. Qunomedical ist ein Berliner HealthTech-Unternehmen, das die Gesundheitsversorgung digitalisiert. Mit unserer Plattform unterstützen wir Patient:innen bei der Suche und Organisation medizinischer Behandlungen. Mit Qunosuite bieten wir Kliniken und medizinischen Anbietern eine digitale Lösung, um ihre Patient:innenprozesse effizient und professionell zu gestalten. Unser internationales Team verbindet Technologie, Healthcare und einen starken Fokus auf die Bedürfnisse unserer Kund:innen.
Wir sind ein Team von 30 internationalen, unternehmerisch denkenden, zielstrebigen und superfreundlichen Kollegen mit Sitz in Berlin, Deutschland. Was jetzt noch fehlt, bist du, ein(e) Senior Finance Manager(in), verantwortlich für alles, was Finanzen ist, nicht nur aus operativer Sicht, sondern auch mit einer starken strategischen Denkweise. Wenn du erste Erfahrungen im Controlling hast und darauf aufbauen möchtest, lies weiter!
Aufgaben

Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für die täglichen operativen Finanz-, Buchhaltungs- und Controlling-Themen
Du unterstützt die Geschäftsplanung und die Berichterstattung über die Zielsetzung
Du definierst und überwachst Finanzkennzahlen und KPIs
Du bist für die Weiterentwicklung und Aktualisierung unseres Finanzmodells verantwortlich
Du stellst die Einhaltung aller deutschen und EU-rechtlichen und regulatorischen Anforderungen sicher
Du arbeitest eng mit unserem CEO, dem Finanzamt und anderen funktionsübergreifenden Teammitgliedern zusammen

Qualifikation

Du hast mehr als 3 Jahre Erfahrung im Controlling, Rechnungswesen und Finanzwesen in einem anderen Start-up-Unternehmen in einem internationalen Umfeld
Du verfügst über fundierte technische und rechtliche Kenntnisse des deutschen Steuerrechts und der Buchhaltung
Du bringst Erfahrung im Umgang mit internationalen Finanzprozessen mit, insbesondere mit Verrechnungspreisen
Du hast Erfahrung mit Finanzmodellierung (du verwendest Excel ohne Maus)
Du bringst die Fähigkeit mit, in einem schnelllebigen, sich schnell verändernden Arbeitsumfeld erfolgreich zu sein
Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch
Ein juristischer Hintergrund/Fachwissen wäre von Vorteil

Benefits

„Keine Politik, kein Bullshit“ – wir leben unsere Werte!
Du kannst wirklich etwas bewirken, das Unternehmen gestalten und mit deinen eigenen Ideen das internationale Wachstum vorantreiben – in einer Branche, die uns alle betrifft
Betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit Arbeitgeberzuschuss
Urban Sports Club Membership
Ein nettes ESOP-Paket

Möchtest du Teil unserer Erfolgsgeschichte werden? Wir freuen uns auf deine Online-Bewerbung.

title: Tech Lead - AI & Innovation
description_clean:
Vicoland gives the professional services market a new dimension: Virtual Companies – "Vicos". We invented Vicos as a new type of supplier, more efficient than traditional professional services firms (consultancies, system integrators, agencies etc.). We have received 20 million € in round A financing.
Vicos may consist of freelancers, SMEs and AI agents. They organize through our AI-driven SaaS platform to act like real companies, competing successfully for large enterprise projects, e g. ERP introductions or AI transformations. Vicos have proven to be more cost-efficient and to deliver better quality than traditional companies.
Already, 120+ Vicos with thousands of freelancers work on projects for enterprise clients like BASF, Miele, Siemens or Daimler and many SME. Forbes and Forrester have named Vicoland as a leading force transforming the market.
Our certified platform is key to our success. It provides the full digital infrastructure which makes Vicos come true as a new form to organize human labor and human-agentic interaction. It covers end-to-end all essential areas: marketing, finance, legal, and organization.
Given its ambitious and transformative purpose, our platform is highly complex (though easy use). Developing it further takes engineers who combine technical excellence, pragmatic judgement and entrepreneurial spirit. The Tech Lead: AI & Innovation we are looking for embodies these qualities in his or her leadership. He or she is up for making a major contribution to our company and to our society.
Tasks

You will lead, grow and enable a team of (forward deployed) engineers: make every engineer successful in their role and hire new ones who strengthen the team.
You will be the only (and main) tech lead for the engineering team, with carreer option to progress to CTO
Own the technical direction and technology decisions for Vicoland. Set the architecture across the stack, from frontend to infrastructure, and make sure what we build is scalable, robust and maintainable.
Stay hands-on: contribute features yourself end-2-end by understanding business needs, coding, building prototypes, and for all that using AI to aggressively ship high-quality software alongside your team.
Translate business needs into technical roadmaps in close cooperation with Business Development, Product and other stakeholders. Prioritize, scope and make trade-offs explicit.
Makre sure each team member can work end-to-end: concept & design, development, QA, deployment and production monitoring, with clear engineering standards and quality gates.
Continuously improve how we build with AI: best practices for context engineering, model selection, evaluation, tracing and observability, so that quality is measured, not assumed.
Run architectural discussions, code reviews and retrospectives; create a culture of ownership, constructive challenge and continuous learning.
Act as a sparring partner to the Chief Product Officer and the business leadership team on technology strategy, build-vs-buy decisions and team setup.

Requirements

Have proven people leadership experience: you have led an engineering team (ideally 3+ engineers), including hiring, performance evaluations, career development and coaching.
Have excelled somewhere through an impactful technical contribution, one which we can talk about, and still enjoy writing code yourself.
Have deep hands-on experience across the stack (frontend, backend, data, infrastructure/cloud) and a track record of architecting and shipping production-grade software, preferably with AI components (LLMs, embeddings, RAG pipelines, autonomous agents, PyTorch/TensorFlow).
Have experience developing AI agents and integrating them into business workflows.
Be on top of the latest tools, models and trends in AI-assisted software engineering. You are excellent at context engineering (incl. prompting), know when to leverage which model, and have first-hand experience with Claude Code or Cursor, and you know how to roll these practices out across a team.
Know how to evaluate what gets built. You can design eval sets, work with LLM-as-judge or ground-truth data, use tracing and observability tooling to find and fix regressions, and make evaluation a team habit.
Practice a truly agnostic approach to stack and tools: you pick the right tech for the problem, not vice versa, and can explain your choices to both engineers and business stakeholders.
Balance autonomy and alignment: you drive your team from idea to finished product independently, while knowing when to involve, align with or escalate to others.
Have the ability to thoughtfully challenge ideas and drive constructive discussions with users, engineers, product, and business leadership.
Lead with humility: you create psychological safety, give and receive honest feedback, and measure your success by the success of your team.
Reside within ±3 hours of Central European Time (to enable effective collaboration), at best in one of our office locations in Barcelona, Berlin, Frankfurt, Leipzig, and Sevilla.
Full professional proficiency in English at C2 level.
Full professional proficiency in German at C1 level.

Bonus Qualifications

Experience building or scaling an engineering team in a startup or scale-up environment.
Prior experience integrating AI into SaaS business workflows, ideally in a client-facing or forward-deployed setup.
Familiarity with the modern AI-tooling ecosystem (agents, memory systems, vector databases, orchestration frameworks).
Experience working with distributed or multi-location teams.

Benefits

You’ll work in an international, closely knit team of high‑performers and entrepreneurial spirits.
Remote‑friendly + flexible work hours.
Excellent compensation + participation in the company through our ESOP.
Growth mindset: Hard skills are important — but mindset matters more. If you meet most of the requirements and you’re hungry to learn, apply anyway.

If you’re a high‑impact tech lead who thrives on autonomy, drives real results, and is passionate about applying AI to change how teams work - let’s talk. Even if you don’t check every bullet above, but you bring exceptional drive, creativity, and a growth mindset, please apply. We believe the right mindset counts more than checkboxes.

title: Account Executive – Strategic Retail, DACH and Central Europe (German Speaking)
description_clean:
Bazaarvoice is looking for an extraordinarily talented, high-performing Account Executive to join our EMEA sales team. This role is designed for a unique, new-business hunter who craves a challenge, thrives outside their comfort zone, and possesses the strategic rigor to manage a high-value retail territory across DACH and Central Europe. 
As an Account Executive for Strategic Retail, you will build a pipeline and drive the sales cycle from start to finish. If you are a consultative storyteller who can navigate complex enterprise organizations, build consensus, and defend a high-ROI solution to C-level executives, we want to hear from you.
Key Responsibilities:


Orchestrate the Territory Ecosystem: Act as the strategic leader of your territory. Conduct account planning, territory management, and continuous pipeline generation, while rallying internal cross-functional resources to maximize coverage and close deals.


End-to-End Deal Architecture: Manage the entire lifecycle of high-value enterprise SaaS deals—from initial prospecting and precise qualification to sophisticated contract negotiation and closure.


Strategic Opportunity Mapping: Move beyond standard discovery to conduct deep-dive analyses into a retailer's business model. Reveal latent pain points and align Bazaarvoice’s high-ROI solutions with their business objectives.


Value Defense & Executive Presence: Partner with a prospect’s marketing, merchandising, and technology staff. Confidently demonstrate and defend the ROI of our platform, successfully building consensus from Marketing Managers up to CMO, CTO, and Procurement levels.


High-Velocity Discipline & Forecasting: Drive urgency throughout the sales funnel, handle objections with resilience, and maintain a high volume of outbound activity. Deliver exceptional qualification and accurate forecasting over a two-quarter period.


Thought Leadership: Stay ahead of e-commerce industry trends, competitor movements, and shifts in consumer behavior to provide proactive strategic guidance.


What You'll Bring:


Proven Track Record: 3 year experience in a customer-facing, new-business SaaS hunter role, with a proven history of managing high-value portfolios and consistently exceeding quotas.


Retail & Digital Savvy: Strong knowledge of and experience selling into large, complex retail organizations.


Strategic & Financial Acumen: Expert in value-selling innovative software in a fast-changing space. Ability to articulate complex ROI models and use data-driven storytelling to win complex "consensus" buys.


Collaborative Leadership: Demonstrated ability to lead internal support teams, articulate a clear account strategy, and secure the internal resources needed to win.


The Bazaarvoice DNA: A high level of enthusiasm, coachability, and an unwavering work ethic. You are comfortable hearing "no," shaking it off, and pivoting your strategy to find the "yes."

Language: German language proficiency at Native or C1 minimum.

Right to Work: Eligibility to work in France without restrictions.


Desirable Criteria:


Industry Background: 3+ years of experience selling e-commerce, MarTech, or digital marketing technology, with established relationships up to the CMO level.


Brand Experience: Experience selling to large consumer brands in addition to major retailers.


Global Mindset: Additional European language skills are a strong plus.


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)


Net New Revenue: Driving net new business within the Retail segment.


Pipeline Velocity & Accuracy: Consistently generating pipeline and moving opportunities through the funnel with speed and precise forecasting.


Cross-Functional Leadership: Successfully leveraging and orchestrating your internal support resources to maximize territory efficiency and deal sizes.

This person will grow our unique community via your blend of tax, data technology, and process improvement experience.

You will be reporting to the Senior Manager of Tax Data & Operations, and play an integral role in DoorDash's data function, owning the processes for ingesting, transforming, and controlling our data, ensuring accuracy, and making it available to analytics and business users.
As a member of this team, you will lead the design, implementation, and operation of data pipelines and related processes to support the Company's exponential growth.

Lead the collection of Tax Data and Reporting requirements through close relationships with Tax team counterparts
Design, build, and maintain scalable, reliable data pipelines (ETL/ELT) that serve data across the company
Develop and optimize data models and warehouse structures to support analytics and reporting
Participate in new business initiatives and identify their impact on existing data system(s) and processes.
Work closely with Analytics, Data Science, and business partners in the development and validation of new data sources.
Identify and document business, functional and technical requirements to support new business initiatives and to enhance existing system functionality.
Leverage AI & AI assisted tooling to build and automate recurring data tasks & pipelines.
Monitor data quality, reliability, and observability, and resolve data-related issues for our internal business partners.
Participate in defining the Company's data tooling needs, including the maintenance of existing systems.
Prepare documentation related to our data systems and processes.
Share knowledge and best practices with engineers and analysts across the team.

You have 7+ years of experience in a Tax data & technology or similar role.
Experience using Data Build Tool (DBT) or a similar product to manage data flows.
Experience using Claude, Cursor and similar AI tools.
You are an expert at using SQL with experience using Snowflake.
Proficiency in Python (or a comparable language) for building data pipelines.
Experience with modern data stack and orchestration tools such as Airflow, Spark, or Kafka.
You have strong attention to detail and analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
You're an independently motivated person with a proven ability to manage multiple projects and prioritize work independently.
You have excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Project management experience, including creation of project plans, milestones, and due dates.
Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related degree.

title: Werksstudenten ISMS & Compliance (m/w/d) - Berlin
description_clean:

Wir sind ausdauernd, wissbegierig, veränderungswillig und unbequem. So verändern wir den Energiesektor hin zu einer kundenorientierten und innovativen Branche und leisten dadurch unseren Beitrag für die zentralen Herausforderungen unserer Zeit.
Energieversorger vertrauen uns ihre Abrechnungsdaten an. Deshalb ist Informationssicherheit bei uns Teil des Produkts. Für unser Büro in Berlin suchen wir eine:n Werkstudent:in ISMS & Compliance (m/w/d), der:die unser nach ISO/IEC 27001:2022 zertifiziertes ISMS mitgestaltet und weiterentwickelt.
Aufgaben
Deine Mission bei uns
Du sorgst mit dafür, dass die Plattform für die Energiewende sicher bleibt. Dabei lernst du Informationssicherheit so kennen, wie sie in einem wachsenden SaaS-Unternehmen tatsächlich gelebt wird.

Halte unser ISMS auditfest: Du unterstützt dabei, die Anforderungen der ISO/IEC 27001:2022 im Alltag umzusetzen und zu überprüfen. Du pflegst Richtlinien, Nachweise und Risikobewertungen und begleitest interne und externe Audits aus erster Reihe.
Mach Sicherheit messbar: Du definierst aussagekräftige KPIs für unser ISMS, erhebst sie möglichst automatisiert und machst sie in Dashboards sichtbar. Aus den Zahlen leitest du konkrete Verbesserungen ab.
Entwickle das ISMS weiter: Du bringst eigene Ideen ein, wie Prozesse schlanker, Kontrollen wirksamer und Dokumentation hilfreicher werden. Dein Ziel ist ein ISMS, das im Arbeitsalltag unterstützt und auch gelebt wird.
Sichere unsere Geräteflotte: Du gestaltest das Mobile Device Management unserer Firmengeräte aktiv mit, von Sicherheitsrichtlinien und Konfigurationsprofilen bis zum Rollout für mobile Geräte.
Gestalte Information Security im KI-Zeitalter: Du findest Antworten auf eine der spannendsten Fragen unserer Branche: Wie setzen wir KI-Tools produktiv ein und schützen gleichzeitig die Daten unserer Kunden zuverlässig? Dafür entwickelst du Richtlinien, Freigabeprozesse und technische Leitplanken, die Sicherheit und Effizienz verbinden.
Zusammenarbeit auf Augenhöhe: Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Engineering-Team und den Verantwortlichen für Informationssicherheit zusammen und übersetzt Sicherheitsanforderungen in praktikable Lösungen.

Qualifikation
Wir glauben fest daran, dass die richtige Einstellung und Motivation oft wichtiger sind als ein lückenloser Lebenslauf.
Das bringst du mit (Must-haves):

Studium mit Tech-Fokus: Du studierst Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, (IT-)Sicherheit, Security Management oder einen vergleichbaren Studiengang, zum Beispiel an der TU Berlin, HTW, BHT oder am HPI in Potsdam.
Echtes Interesse an Informationssicherheit: Du hast erste Berührungspunkte gesammelt, etwa über Vorlesungen, Projekte, CTFs oder dein eigenes Homelab, und willst wissen, wie Security in der Praxis funktioniert.
Technisches Grundverständnis: Du verstehst, wie Cloud-Infrastruktur, Identitäts- und Zugriffsmanagement und Endgeräte zusammenspielen. Mit Python, Bash oder TypeScript automatisierst du wiederkehrende Aufgaben.
KI-gestützte Arbeitsweise: Du nutzt KI-Tools gezielt, prüfst ihre Ergebnisse kritisch und hast ein Gespür dafür, welche Daten in welches Tool gehören.
Struktur und Sorgfalt: Du arbeitest gewissenhaft, behältst auch bei vielen Anforderungen den Überblick und schreibst Dokumentation, die andere gerne lesen.
Zeit für uns: Du kannst 15–20 Stunden pro Woche in der Vorlesungszeit einplanen, idealerweise für mindestens 12 Monate.
Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse: Du kommunizierst sicher in beiden Sprachen, im Team ebenso wie mit Auditoren.

Framework-Wissen: Du hast dich bereits mit ISO 27001, BSI IT-Grundschutz oder NIS2 beschäftigt.

Branchenwissen: Die Energiewende interessiert dich und du willst verstehen, wie die Daten hinter unserer Abrechnung funktionieren.

Benefits
Wir wollen nicht nur, dass du bei uns arbeitest - wir wollen, dass du mit uns wächst. Dein Wachstum & deine Karriere:

Steile Lernkurve: In direkter Zusammenarbeit mit einem erfahrenen Team kannst du dich schnell und nachhaltig weiterentwickeln.
Gestaltungsspielraum: Bringe deine eigenen Ideen ein und baue mit uns die Strukturen für unseren zukünftigen Erfolg auf.
Perspektive über das Studium hinaus: Wenn es für beide Seiten passt, hast du die Option, nach deinem Werkstudentenjob bei uns weiterzumachen.

Dein Arbeitsalltag:

Flexibilität, die zum Studium passt: Du verteilst deine Stunden flexibel auf die Woche, auch in kurzen Blöcken von wenigen Stunden pro Arbeitstag. So bleibt genug Raum für Vorlesungen und Prüfungen.
Berlin als Basis: Dein Arbeitsplatz ist unser Büro in Berlin. Dort arbeitest du regelmäßig mit dem Team zusammen. Ergänzend ist Remote Office möglich.

Leidenschaft & Teamgeist: Wir sind ein passioniertes Team, das für seine Mission brennt und Erfolge gemeinsam feiert.
