Our SmartSorting Hubs combine advanced sorting technology, automation and AI to transform how complex scrap is processed, turning selected mixed streams into better-defined industrial feedstock while improving material quality and traceability.Join us at a defining stage as we bring the $600 billion scrap metals industry into the 21st century and build a new global standard for secondary metals.READY TO MAKE AN IMPACT? We are looking for an experienced Data Analyst who turns complex operational and business data into clear insights, better decisions, and measurable improvements. You bring strong hands-on experience in data analysis, SQL, visualisation, and working with large and imperfect datasets - and understand how to connect data to real-world processes and business outcomes.This is an integrated role at the intersection of business, operations, and technology. You’ll work directly with teams to understand their data needs, dig into the details hands-on, and find the right way to answer their questions - whether through SQL, Excel, dashboards, or other tools. You’ll also translate recurring needs into requirements for Engineering and help build stable, automated reporting and analytics over time, particularly across our trading business.Join our international team and play a key role in shaping innovative solutions for scrap metal processing - using data and technology to build a more efficient and sustainable future.YOUR MISSIONAnalytics & Insights: Turn complex business questions into clear, actionable analysis, identifying trends, opportunities, risks, and the key drivers behind business performance. Work directly with the people who have the data need to understand their questions, challenge assumptions, and turn raw data into meaningful insights and decisions.Data Foundations: Build and maintain the data transformations needed to turn raw data into clean, reliable, analysis-ready datasets in the Data Warehouse. Work hands-on with imperfect data, validate its accuracy and meaning, and identify gaps or inconsistencies in how data is captured.Data Modelling: Translate business requirements into well-structured, reusable data models and clearly defined metrics that provide a trusted source of truth for analytics across the organisation.Data Quality: Implement and maintain data quality checks and tests to ensure data is accurate, consistent, complete, and fresh - proactively identifying and resolving issues with relevant stakeholders and working with Engineering to improve how underlying data is captured.Reporting & Self-Service: Build and support dashboards, reports, and analytical datasets that are intuitive, performant, and optimised for internal reporting and self-service analytics. Help turn recurring analytical needs and ad-hoc analysis into stable, scalable, and increasingly automated reporting.Stakeholder Partnership: Work closely with Product, Operations, Finance, Marketing, Engineering, and other teams to understand business needs, challenge assumptions, and translate them into meaningful analytical questions and solutions. title: Junior Consultant – Vertrieb & Recruiting in einer Rolle (m/w/d)
description_clean:
Jobbeschreibung
Junior Consultant – Vertrieb & Recruiting in einer Rolle (m/w/d)
Du bist ehrgeizig, smart und willst nicht jahrelang warten, bis man dir Verantwortung gibt? Dann lies weiter.
Bei den großen Personaldienstleistern lernst du erst monatelang Recruiting, bevor du überhaupt an den Vertrieb darfst. Bei uns nicht. Als Junior Consultant (m/w/d) übernimmst du von Anfang an den kompletten Zyklus: Du gewinnst Kunden, berätst sie strategisch – und setzt die Recruiting-Projekte anschließend selbst um. Eine Rolle, doppelte Kompetenz, volle Verantwortung für deinen Erfolg.
Wir sind eine wachsende Recruiting-Beratung mitten in Bielefeld und helfen Unternehmen, ihre Arbeitgebermarke zu stärken und planbar qualifizierte Talente zu gewinnen – mit datenbasiertem Recruiting und strukturiertem Vertrieb. Und wir arbeiten in einem Markt, der durch Fachkräftemangel und demografischen Wandel jedes Jahr weiter wächst.
Profitiere als Junior Consultant (m/w/d) von unseren Benefits:

Attraktives Fixgehalt + ungedeckelte Bonuszahlungen: Deine Leistung entscheidet, was am Monatsende auf deinem Konto landet – nach oben offen.
Unbefristete Festanstellung: Wir bauen langfristig auf dich – Zukunftssicherheit in einer Branche, die durch die Digitalisierung und den Fachkräftemangel stetig wächst.
Echte 360°-Entwicklung: Du baust dir Kompetenz in Vertrieb UND Recruiting auf – das Profil, das im Markt am gefragtesten ist. Klarer Entwicklungspfad: Recruiter → Junior Consultant → Senior Consultant.
Strukturiertes Onboarding & Coaching: Umfassende Einarbeitung, professionelle Schulungen in Recruiting, Beratung und Vertrieb sowie regelmäßige Feedback-Sessions
Premium-Arbeitsplatz: Höhenverstellbare Tische, Herman Miller-Stühle, Apple-Technik (MacBook Air/Pro, iMac) – mitten in der Bielefelder Innenstadt.
Gesundheit im Fokus: Premium-Fitnessvertrag bei einem Studio deiner Wahl.
Top-Versorgung im Office: Faema E61-Siebträgermaschine mit Julius Meinl-Kaffee, hochwertige Tees und flexibles Lunch-System von Meyer Menü
Teamkultur auf Augenhöhe: Kollegiale, leistungsorientierte Atmosphäre mit direktem Draht zur Geschäftsführung – deine Ideen werden gehört und umgesetzt.

Deine spannenden Aufgaben als Junior Consultant (m/w/d):
Vertrieb – du gewinnst die Projekte:

Du kontaktierst aktiv potenzielle Neukunden per Telefon und Direktansprache und weckst Interesse an unseren digitalen Recruiting-Lösungen.
Du analysierst die Recruiting-Herausforderungen der Unternehmen, identifizierst konkreten Handlungsbedarf und entwickelst maßgeschneiderte Strategien.
Du präsentierst deine Lösungen überzeugend und begleitest den Prozess bis zum Abschluss.

Recruiting – du setzt sie um:

Nach Vertragsabschluss steuerst du das Projekt eigenständig weiter – von der Kampagnenplanung bis zur erfolgreichen Besetzung.
Du koordinierst eingehende Bewerbungen, qualifizierst Kandidaten vor und sorgst für eine professionelle Candidate Experience.

Dein Fundament:

Du dokumentierst deine Aktivitäten sauber im CRM, behältst deine Pipeline im Blick und arbeitest zielorientiert auf deine KPIs hin.
Du arbeitest eng mit Marketing und Geschäftsführung zusammen und bringst Ideen zur Optimierung unserer Prozesse ein.

Das bringst du idealerweise mit

Vertriebsaffinität: Du hast Freude an Akquise und willst aktiv neue Kunden gewinnen – am Telefon, per Video-Call oder persönlich.
Beratungsverständnis: Du erkennst Potenziale, stellst die richtigen Fragen und präsentierst Lösungen strukturiert.
Menschenkenntnis: Du verstehst sowohl die Unternehmens- als auch die Bewerberperspektive.
Eigeninitiative & Leistungswille: Du arbeitest selbstständig, bleibst auch nach einem "Nein" am Ball und willst überdurchschnittliche Ergebnisse erzielen.
Wichtig: Ob Studium, Ausbildung oder Quereinstieg mit Vertriebserfahrung – uns interessiert nicht dein Lebenslauf, sondern dein Hunger. Recruiting-Vorerfahrung ist ein Plus, kein Muss – das Handwerk bringen wir dir bei.

So geht's weiter
1. Bewerben in 2 Minuten – ohne Anschreiben, Lebenslauf genügt.
2. Kurzes Kennenlern-Telefonat – wir melden uns innerhalb von 48 Stunden.
3. Persönliches Gespräch in unserem Office in der Bielefelder Innenstadt.
Nimm deinen Erfolg JETZT selbst in die Hand – wir freuen uns auf dich!

title: Full Stack Engineer (m/f/d)
description_clean: TL;DRJoin GlassDollar and help build the system some of Europe's largest companies use to find, test, and adopt startup technology.We're looking for an engineer who wants considerably more responsibility than "implement what's in the ticket". You'll take an ambiguous problem, shape it together with product, make the important technical decisions, ship it, and stay close enough to see whether it worked.We expect you to have opinions. We also expect you to be good enough to change them.The problem we're solvingLarge organisations are remarkably good at accumulating problems. A company with 100,000 employees can have thousands of operational challenges across its business units. Somewhere outside that organisation, a startup has probably already built part of the solution. Getting those two things to meet still happens through spreadsheets, long email threads, and meetings whose primary output is another meeting.GlassDollar OS is the operating system for venture clienting: problem → startup discovery → evaluation → PoC → adoption, in one repeatable workflow.Our customers are some of Europe's largest organisations, so the software has to move quickly and behave like something an enterprise can depend on. That tension creates the interesting engineering problems.What we're looking forYou can take a problem further than the ticket. Work often starts with something incomplete, like "customers need a better way to manage X". You'll shape the problem with product, challenge assumptions, and decide what belongs in this iteration. Strong opinions about what we build, not only how, are expected here.You care about product. You want to know who you're building for, why the problem matters, and what success looks like. That context should shape your technical decisions.You have technical judgement. There is rarely one correct architecture. You know when the boring solution beats the ambitious one, when an abstraction helps and when it hides the problem, and when a small feature is about to create six months of technical debt. We expect you to reason about API boundaries, data models, permissions, performance, failure modes, testing, observability, and rollout, and to raise concerns with a clear argument attached.You make the system better, not just the feature. You fix the spreading pattern rather than the single instance, make an API easier for the next person, and improve tests because the current setup makes everyone afraid to deploy. Your impact should show beyond the pull requests with your name on them.You can work across the stack. A feature might run from a React interaction through GraphQL into a Node service, a schema redesign, a permissions update, and a safe migration for existing customers. Curiosity to follow the problem matters more than equal depth everywhere.You own quality. We have QA. That's not where quality begins. What breaks if this request happens twice? What happens with old data, or when the API fails halfway through? We use Playwright and Jest alongside reviews and monitoring. The goal isn't coverage, it's confidence.You communicate like your decisions will matter later. Six months from now, somebody should understand an important decision without digging through seventeen Slack messages and a deleted Notion comment. That means writing things down when they matter, explaining trade-offs clearly, giving useful code reviews, and surfacing risks before they become incidents.You raise the engineering bar around you. You do not need a management title to have influence. Find the hole in an architecture, unblock someone without taking the keyboard away, disagree without turning every decision into a referendum. As you earn trust, you’ll naturally become the person people bring harder problems to.What you'll doOver your first year:Enterprise integrations: into our customers' systems, data, identity providers, and workflows. This is what turns GlassDollar from software somebody logs into, into infrastructure their organisation operates on.APIs and MCP: public REST APIs and MCP servers for our customers, their engineers, and increasingly their AI agents. The interesting part isn't exposing endpoints, it's designing an external platform we'll still be happy supporting years from now.AI inside real workflows: embeddings, vector search, and LLMs across a large database of startups and corporate innovation data. We're less interested in adding a ✨ button to everything than in finding places where AI removes real work.Workflow automation: triggers, notifications, and automation that replace humans moving information between systems.Core product engineering: React interfaces, APIs, PostgreSQL queries, permissions, migrations, performance work, and the occasional bug whose root cause makes everybody stare silently at their screen.Our stackFrontend: TypeScript, React, Material UI, Apollo Client, PlaywrightBackend: Node.js, GraphQL, Prisma, PostgreSQL, JestInfrastructure: AWS, Terraform, GitHub Actions, SentryIncreasingly: LLM APIs, embeddings, vector search, MCP, AI-assisted engineering workflowsYou don't need experience with every item. Reasoning about systems matters more to us than having memorised our exact stack.RequirementsSubstantial production experience with TypeScript, React, and Node.jsComfortable reasoning about relational databases, not just the ORMCan independently take a feature from unclear starting point to productionCan read unfamiliar code without immediately proposing a rewriteNice to have:Experience with GraphQL, Prisma, or PostgreSQL at scaleExposure to LLM APIs, embeddings, or vector searchExperience owning systems, not just featuresDon't check every box? Apply anyway. We'd rather have the conversation than lose someone over a bullet point.How we hireHow we workWe're a small engineering team, so there are fewer places for responsibility to disappear and no chain of five people between you and a decision. We prefer written context over meetings the calendar invented, and working software over elaborate process.Quickly doesn't mean carelessly. Sometimes the fastest route is the simple version today, sometimes it's another day on a foundation twenty future features will sit on. Knowing which situation you're in is part of the job. Expect to ship to production very early.How we hireNo seven-stage endurance test. No algorithm trivia disconnected from the work.Intro. If there's strong mutual conviction, we move.One last thingJob descriptions have a habit of producing candidates who optimise themselves against bullet points. Please don't. title: IT-Systemspezialist für Medizintechnik (m/w/d)
description_clean:
für die Doceins Lungenklinik Neustadt GmbH
Kennziffer: LKN-02
Unsere Doceins Lungenklinik Neustadt im Südharz ist eine der größten Lungenfachkliniken in Thüringen. Unser Haus ist hochmodern ausgestattet und als spezialisiertes Kompetenz- und Leistungszentrum für Pneumologie anerkannt. Das Krankenhaus verfügt über 80 aufgestellte Betten auf 4 Stationen, davon 20 Intensivbetten. Als spezialisierte Akutklinik für Lungen- und Atemwegserkrankungen liegt der diagnostische und therapeutische Schwerpunkt unseres Hauses im Bereich der Pneumologie, der Beatmungs- und Intensivmedizin sowie der Schlafmedizin. Wir sind ein nach DGP zertifiziertes Weaningzentrum und Zentrum für außerklinische Beatmung.
Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt eine/n rückenbauer/in zwischen IT und Medizintechnik. Sie sind der technische Allrounder an der Nahtstelle von klinischer IT-Infrastruktur und Medizingeräten. In dieser strategisch wichtigen Position verbinden Sie Anwendungswissen in Krankenhausinformationssystemen (KIS) mit technischem Know-how zu Medizingeräten – und sorgen so für sichere, effiziente und konforme Prozesse in unserem Krankenhaus. Ihre Arbeit ermöglicht es, dass medizinische Geräte nahtlos in digitale Workflows integriert werden, Daten sicher fließen und Systeme zuverlässig laufen – zum Wohl unserer Patient:innen und Mitarbeiter:innen.
Aufgaben

Netzwerkintegration von Medizingeräten:
Planung, Konfiguration und Einbindung von medizinischen Geräten (z. B.
Bildgebung, Monitoringsysteme, Laborgeräte) in die klinische
IT-Infrastruktur (KIS, PACS, RIS etc.).
Schnittstellenanalyse und -optimierung:
Zusammenarbeit mit Herstellern, IT-Abteilung und Medizintechnik, um
Datenflüsse (HL7, DICOM, FHIR etc.) zu sichern und Interoperabilität zu
gewährleisten.
Fehleranalyse und Störungsmanagement: Identifikation und Behebung von technischen Problemen an der Schnittstelle zwischen Geräten und IT-Systemen.
Organisation von Ausfallsicherheit und Hochverfügbarkeit: Redundanzkonzepte, Backups, Notfallpläne etc.
Compliance: Unterstützung bei der Sicherstellung der Einhaltung von externen und internen Vorgaben für Medizintechnik und IT-Systeme
Lebenszyklusmanagement von Medizingeräten: Installation, Konfiguration, Wartung und Deinstallation
Pflege der technischen Dokumentation: z. B. Medizinproduktebuch, Inventarlisten, Wartungsprotokolle, Softwareversionen, Netzwerkkonfigurationen
Update- und Patch-Management: Koordination von Software-Updates für Medizingeräte unter Berücksichtigung von Klinikbetriebs- und Sicherheitsanforderungen.
Ersatzbeschaffung: Begleitung von Ausschreibungen, Evaluierungen und Migrationen neuer Systeme.
Beratung und Schulung: Beratung der IT- und
Medizintechnik-Teams sowie Schulung der Anwender/innen (Ärzt/innen,
Pflegekräfte, MTRA etc.) zu technischen Fragen

Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in IT-Infrastruktur, Medizintechnik oder KIS-Administration

Verständnis für Medizinprodukteklassifizierung (Klasse I–III) und Regulatorien (MPG, MDR, IEC 62366)

Erfahrung mit Server- und Client-Betriebssystemen (Windows Server, Linux).

Teamplayer-Mentalität mit Eigeninitiative und Verantwortungsbewusstsein

Belastbarkeit und Flexibilität in einem dynamischen Umfeld (z. B. Notfälle, Wartungsfenster)

Benefits

Verantwortungsvolle Aufgabe mit Gestaltungsspielraum innerhalb flacher Hierarchien

title: Chief Technology Officer (all identities)
description_clean:
Das erwartet Dich
Caspar Health is entering its next growth phase. Our digital care is becoming increasingly critical to clinic and hospital operations. At the same time, we are progressing towards medical-device obligations and expanding AI-enabled ways of working.
As CTO, you will own Technology and Engineering at C-level. You will report to the CEO, lead Engineering with full functional and disciplinary responsibility and work as a peer to the CPO.
Your job is not to become the bottleneck or Caspar's most important individual technologist. You will build a strong leadership layer and an Engineering system that moves quickly with security, resilience and evidence. You will stay close enough to technology to judge important decisions, risks and AI-enabled development through current practice.
This position is based in Germany and must be performed, living in Germany. Due to our current payroll and social security arrangements, we cannot offer permanent employment from abroad. Applicants must therefore be able to perform their duties from Germany starting on their first day of work and must already have the necessary authorization to work in Germany.
Deine Herausforderungen

Translate company and product strategy into a technology strategy with clear capabilities, investments, risks and measurable 18-month proof points.
Lead all Engineering teams and Engineering leads, including Platform, Infrastructure, DevOps/SRE, developer experience and Engineering-owned quality automation.
Build a strong leadership layer, clear domain ownership, distributed knowledge and resilient internal and external capacity without single-person dependencies.
Own architecture, technology choices, reliability, security implementation, technical evidence and reporting, and regulated development for critical clinic and hospital workflows. Keep Caspar ready for deep technical scrutiny with current architecture and ownership evidence, demonstrable Caspar IP ownership, auditable security and compliance evidence, a credible AI story and no critical single-person dependencies.
Own the incident system and lead major or trust-critical escalations. You are not the standing first-line on-call engineer. Ensure postmortem actions are completed and verified.
Plan the Engineering budget and capacity. Decide within the approved envelope on technology, vendors and build, buy or outsource options, including lifecycle cost and continuity.
Shape AI-enabled Engineering through current personal practice. Create measurable leverage without weakening security, maintainability, review quality, traceability or regulated assurance.
Make credible commitments with Product. Product owns outcomes and scope intent. You own technical feasibility, capacity and release readiness, and stop unsupported or unsafe commitments.
Involve Medical, Quality, Information Security, Privacy and Legal early. Engineering turns requirements into reusable controls, tests and evidence. Independent functions retain review, stop and risk-acceptance rights.
Establish clear data contracts with Data. Technology owns production and operational data systems. Data owns semantics, certified analytical datasets, metric governance, analytical quality, experimentation and decision science.
Represent Caspar in high-stakes technical discussions with clinics, hospital IT, integration partners, auditors, investors and the board.

What success looks like
In your first year, you will:

Build a strong Engineering leadership layer and accountable ownership for critical systems
Connect technology choices and investment to company strategy and reviewable proof points, then complete a deep external technical review at customer, auditor or investor standard with no unresolved material findings
Improve delivery predictability, release quality, resilience and regulated evidence
Make cooperation between Engineering, Infrastructure and independent Security durable and effective
Create measurable impact through AI-enabled Engineering without weakening security or quality

Dein Profil

You have managed multiple Engineering leaders and led a multi-team organization through a meaningful scale or rigor transition.
You have owned technology strategy, budget, capacity and build, buy or outsource decisions at executive level, with evidence of their impact.
You have led Engineering in regulated, security-critical or high-availability systems. Medical-device or digital-health experience is a plus, not a prerequisite.
You have built and scaled cloud-SaaS products, ideally in a regulated environment. Health-tech or medical-device experience is a plus, not a prerequisite. You also bring broad systems depth across backend services, web and mobile clients, APIs and integrations, data flows, observability, security and operations. Our exact stack is not a hard filter.
You currently work hands-on with agentic development workflows and can show how you used, constrained or rejected AI output and made it scale
You have shipped products that achieved meaningful customer and business outcomes and bring product judgement and pace, not only engineering rigor. You can challenge Product constructively, make business and technical trade-offs explicit and protect credible commitments under pressure.
You build trust with teams, customers, partners, auditors, investors and boards without acting as a rescuer or creating dependence on yourself.
You are business-fluent in German and English.

A university degree or fixed number of years is not required. We care about demonstrated impact, judgement and responsibility you have personally carried.
Warum Caspar Health?

A genuine C-level mandate with ownership of Engineering and company technology strategy.
The opportunity to combine speed and rigor for digital clinical workflows and make a tangible difference to care.
A clear Product-Technology peer model with shared decisions instead of hidden hand-offs.
Remote-first within Germany with flexible working hours. Regular in-person leadership in Berlin is part of the role. There is no fixed weekly office quota. You will spend time with clinics, partners and at important meetings when useful.
A virtual equity package (VSOP) with meaningful participation in the company's value growth, plus 30 vacation days, a home-office allowance, meal subsidy and a budget for learning, conferences and coaching.
High level of ownership and decision-making freedom – no micromanagement. We hire experts who know what they’re doing. #MakeAnImpact!
Genuine collaboration – no silos, no egos. After all, we’re all working toward the same vision. #ValueFocus!
Access to all Caspar offerings for mental and physical well-being #HealthyTogether!
And yes – all the snacks your heart desires, group sports sessions, a never-empty drinks fridge, and a healthy dose of humor are included too

title: Senior Campaign Analyst
description_clean:
Who we are
JustWatch delivers data-driven digital marketing for the global entertainment business. From the biggest blockbusters to award-winning shows, major sporting events, and best-selling console games. Not only are we entertainment obsessives ourselves, but we also own the world's largest streaming guide, which gives us unparalleled data and insights on audience behaviours and content tastes.
From a small startup, we've evolved into a 200+ strong team, based in Berlin, around the world, or working remotely. We've been all about building a profitable business while riding that wave of impressive growth.
Who we need
Our Campaign team consists of more than 75+ specialists - and it keeps growing: As our new Senior Campaign Analyst, you are the go-to person for all kinds of data-related requests, reports, and their automation. Your expertise will ensure that our campaigns are fueled by accurate data, actionable insights, and efficient reporting processes.
Learn where your talents can be developed, deliver at your peak, and create value in your work.Join us and experience a workplace that's the perfect fit for your talent.What you will be doing
Collaborate with our Business Intelligence department to maintain correct and clearly defined data and KPIs in campaign dashboards.
Stay informed about exceptions made for different clients, reflecting them in reports and analyses.
Accelerate the reporting process for the campaigns team.
Design and provide dashboards, along with data for weekly and monthly reports.
Ensure data sanity in our tools, Thoughtspot/Lightdash, and maintain data quality in external dashboards.
Proactively detect the optimisation potential in our media campaigns.
Conducting benchmarking and forecasting activities.
What we need from you
Proven experience in marketing analytics or a related field, with a deep understanding of business models and digital marketing channels.
Deep understanding of the channels we use (Meta, TikTok, DV360) and their relevant KPIs, including their definition.
Strong analytical skills and the ability to derive actionable insights from complex datasets, KPIs, and benchmarks.
Exceptional skills in Excel and Google Spreadsheets, with the ability to quickly set up reports with data from various sources efficiently.
Excellent communication skills, with the capacity to convey technical information to non-technical stakeholders effectively, and simplify complex scenarios, bringing clarity and focus.
Ability to remain composed and deliver error-free reports and dashboards even in high-pressure, stressful situations with tight deadlines, when faced with obstacles.
A can-do attitude and positive mindset with a proactive approach to overcoming challenges and a passion for driving continuous improvement.
Great conduct in English. German is a plus.
Constant learning, delivering results, and creating value are the core characteristics of everyone at JustWatch, and we are looking for these values in every person we hire.
What we offer you
An open-minded and international team that loves to collaborate to reach our goals.
We prioritise meaningful work over perks, and that true fulfilment comes from intrinsic motivation, personal growth, and making a lasting impact.
We believe in a permission-less environment that lets us focus on delivering value without overcomplicating things.
We trust our skilled professionals to maintain a no-nonsense attitude and create an environment that promotes innovation.
We are committed to helping you achieve your personal and professional goals, and we offer a collaborative and supportive environment to do so.
Truly a hybrid work environment. You are not required to come to the office, but you will want to.

Media is important to us, and we are always happy to hear from people who enjoy film! If you feel like you are missing some of the hard skills, don’t worry, we are hiring for the attitude, values, and personality. 
 
If we caught your attention and you're eager to delve into our perspectives and thought processes, we recommend immersing yourself in our blog post, which elaborates on these subjects:

A company culture that really works
Audience as a Service
Or visit our blog here: https://www.justwatch.com/blog

How to apply
Just hit the apply button and leave us your CV, some basic info, and a short introduction that helps us get to know you. Tell us what motivates you, why you want to work at JustWatch, and how you think you can help us achieve our goals.
Please only apply if you are genuinely interested. Copy-paste mass applications will receive a copy-paste rejection email. The same goes for applications that rely heavily on AI-generated content. We want to get to know you as a person first, not your prompts.
If you have any questions, please reach out to our Talent Team via LinkedIn or apply directly through our jobs page.
Research shows women apply when meeting 100% qualifications, men at 60%. JustWatch welcomes all candidates, especially women and marginalized groups. Apply, let's talk and explore if you're a great fit.

title: Full Stack Product Developer (m/w/d)
description_clean: Aufgaben  Du willst Technologie gestalten, die direkt etwas bewegt? Bei Table.Briefings entwickeln wir digitale Produkte für ein wachsendes Medienunternehmen. Unsere Software hilft dabei, Prozesse effizienter zu machen, neue Geschäftsmodelle zu ermöglichen und unseren Redaktionen den Rücken freizuhalten – damit sie sich auf das konzentrieren können, was sie am besten können: hochwertigen Journalismus!Als dritter interner Entwickler bzw. dritte interne Entwicklerin übernimmst du eine zentrale Rolle in unserem Tech-Team. Du arbeitest an der gesamten Entwicklungskette: von der ersten Idee über Konzeption und Umsetzung bis zu Deployment, Betrieb und Weiterentwicklung.Dabei geht es nicht nur darum, Features zu programmieren. Du hilfst uns, die richtigen Probleme zu erkennen, Anforderungen zu schärfen und Lösungen zu entwickeln, die für unser Business, unsere Nutzerinnen und Nutzer und unsere Redaktionen wirklich einen Unterschied machen. Deine Aufgaben Du konzipierst, entwickelst und betreust unsere Webanwendungen, APIs und Apps.Du arbeitest an unseren Statamic-basierten Plattformen und entwickelst unser CMS weiter.Du entwickelst neue Funktionen mit unserem bestehenden Tech-Stack und verbesserst bestehende Lösungen kontinuierlich.Du beschäftigst dich mit dem Einsatz und der Optimierung von Large Language Models und Coding Agents– zur Automatisierung interner Prozesse und für neue Produktfeatures.Du entwickelst und integrierst RESTful APIs, zum Beispiel zur Anbindung von Systemen wie ActiveCampaign.Du wirkst bei der Konfiguration, Wartung und Absicherung unserer Linux-Server und Deployment-Prozesse mit.Du übersetzt Anforderungen aus unterschiedlichen Bereichen in klare technische Lösungen.Du bringst Struktur in komplexe oder noch nicht vollständig definierte Aufgaben und sorgst dafür, dass aus Ideen umsetzbare Produkte werden.Du arbeitest eng mit Stakeholdern, Produktverantwortlichen, Redaktion und Geschäftsführung zusammen.Unser Tech-Stack - Wir arbeiten unter anderem mit: PHP und LaravelStatamicPostgreSQLLivewireHTML, CSS und JavaScriptRESTful APIsLinux-Servern und modernen Deployment-ProzessenLarge Language Models und Coding AgentsDu musst unseren Tech-Stack nicht bereits vollständig beherrschen – wichtiger sind uns dein technisches Verständnis, deine Kommunikationsstärke und deine Fähigkeit, komplexe Anforderungen schnell in gute Lösungen zu übersetzen. Du solltest aber Lust haben, mit unseren Technologien zu arbeiten und dich schnell in neue Systeme und Themen einzuarbeiten. Wir suchen keine Person, die jedes Tool schon einmal eingesetzt hat, sondern jemanden, der gute technische Entscheidungen trifft, Zusammenhänge versteht und Verantwortung übernimmt.QualifikationDu hast fundierte Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung und beherrschst mindestens eine relevante Programmiersprache sicher.Du hast idealerweise Erfahrung mit Webanwendungen, APIs und Datenbanken.Du interessierst dich für unseren Tech-Stack und hast Lust, dich inLaravel,Statamic, PostgreSQL und Livewire einzuarbeiten oder darin weiterzuentwickeln.Du verstehst, wie man LLMs und CodingAgentssinnvoll und verantwortungsvoll in der Softwareentwicklung einsetzt – oder möchtest es lernen.Du kennst dich mit Linux-Servern,Deploymentund grundlegenden Fragen der IT-Sicherheit aus oder bist bereit, dich in diese Themen einzuarbeiten.Du kannst komplexe Probleme schnell erfassen, priorisieren und in konkrete nächste Schritte übersetzen.Du kommunizierst klar und gerne – auch mit Menschen, die nicht technisch arbeiten.Du kannst unterschiedliche Anforderungen und Perspektiven zusammenbringen und sicher mit Stakeholdern umgehen.Du arbeitest selbstständig, zuverlässig und lösungsorientiert.Du behältst auch dann den Überblick, wenn Anforderungen sich verändern, Informationen zunächst unvollständig sind oder mehrere Themen gleichzeitig auf dem Tisch liegen.Du hast Freude daran, in solchen Situationen Ruhe, Struktur und Verbindlichkeit zu schaffen.Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sind für die Kommunikation im Team und mit unseren Stakeholdern unerlässlich.Was uns wichtig istWir entwickeln nicht zum Selbstzweck. Unser Ziel ist Software, die unmittelbar Wirkung entfaltet: für unser Geschäft, für die Vervielfachung unserer Lizenzen und für unsere Redaktionen, die täglich anspruchsvolle Inhalte produzieren.Dafür suchen wir eine Persönlichkeit, die Verantwortung übernimmt, Fragen stellt und sich aktiv einbringt. Du solltest dich in einem meinungsstarken, dynamischen Umfeld wohlfühlen, unterschiedliche Perspektiven aushalten und deine eigenen Ideen überzeugend vertreten können. Gleichzeitig ist uns wichtig, dass du pragmatisch bleibst und gemeinsam mit anderen zu guten Lösungen kommst.BenefitsWir bieten dir: Eine Schlüsselposition in einem innovativen und wachstumsstarken MedienunternehmenDie Möglichkeit,unseren Tech-Stackaktiv mitzugestalten und weiterzuentwickelnViel Eigenverantwortung und kurze EntscheidungswegeEinen vielseitigen Job mit direktem Einfluss auf unser Business und unsere ProdukteEine unbefristete Festanstellung in Teilzeit oder Vollzeit28 Tage UrlaubFlexibilität bei Arbeitszeit und Arbeitsort > Drei Tage pro Woche in unserem Büro in Berlin-Mitte, zwei Tage im MobileOfficePersönliche und fachliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in einer echten WachstumskulturEine offene, freundliche Atmosphäre mit Partnerinnen, Partnern und Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus der ganzen WeltDeine Bewerbung Wir freuen uns auf deinen Lebenslauf und ein kurzes, persönliches Motivationsschreiben mit maximal 1.000 Zeichen: Warum möchtest du als Full Stack Product Developer (m/w/d) bei Table.Briefings arbeiten? Uns interessiert besonders, welche Probleme du gerne löst, wie du mit unterschiedlichen Anforderungen umgehst und was dich daran reizt, Technologie mit konkretem unternehmerischem und redaktionellem Nutzen zu entwickeln.Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Backend Engineer (f/m/d)
description_clean: Our OpportunityOver the past three years, Predium has built the leading real estate intelligence platform for ESG and value management in the DACH region - with the strongest names in the industry as customers: asset managers, housing companies, banks. Our customer base, our data, our credibility - that's valuable capital for the next step. Investment, credit, and asset management decisions in real estate are still made in Excel, case by case. We're now building the AI analyst that takes this work off people's hands - working directly on the customer's own data, scalable without adding headcount. We're well-funded, and we're bringing AI into real estate.Your MissionAs a Senior Backend Engineer, you own the systems behind our platform: the GraphQL API, the relational data model, the background processing that turns customer documents and spreadsheets into structured data, and the permission model that lets a single owner and a bank with hundreds of portfolios use the same product. Most of your work runs from schema design all the way to the resolver.You partner with product, design and other engineers to make sure we build what matters - not just what you have been told to do. You take real responsibility for production: when something is slow, you find out why, whether the answer is a bad query, application code or the infrastructure underneath.You also help us make AI reliable in production. Document extraction, long-running analysis jobs and agentic features are core to where the product is going, and we need people who make these workflows testable and dependable rather than impressive in a demo.Our company size of ~40 people ensures that the best idea wins and political discussions are kept aside. And every line of code helps to improve the carbon footprint of real estate properties.Tech stack: TypeScript (NestJS backend, React frontend), Hasura/GraphQL, PostgreSQL (multiple databases incl. PostGIS), queue-based job processing, AWS (ECS / Elastic Beanstalk, S3, SES, Textract), IaC, Claude but all agents welcomeWhat you'll ownBuild features across our Hasura GraphQL API, NestJS and Postgres. From schema design to resolver.Model complex real estate and ESG domains in relational schemas. We run several Postgres databases side by side (one of them geospatial), and schema decisions here have consequences but also positive impact.Own background processing: Excel imports, document extraction, long-running analysis jobs, 3D and image processing. Queues, retries, jobs that spawn other jobs - and figuring out what to do when step 3 of 7 fails at 2am.Develop our permission model. Customers range from a single owner to enterprises with organization/portfolio/building-level access.Integrate LLMs into backend workflows - especially document and data extraction - and make them reliable, verifyable and testable.Debug production. Navigate Grafana dashboards and traces to find out why something is slow or failing, whether in the app, the CI/build pipeline or the infrastructure.Spot overgrown or overly complex parts of the codebase and simplify them without being asked. Paying down complexity is part of the job.What success looks likeYou have shipped features end-to-end across schema, API and background processing that our customers actively use.Our async processing (imports, extraction, analysis jobs) is measurably more robust: fewer silent failures, clear retry and recovery paths, and observability that tells us what broke and why.You have taken ownership of at least one core area e.g. the permission model, the job orchestration layer or the LLM extraction pipeline and are the person the team goes to for it.You have raised the bar on testing and developer experience in the backend, and other engineers ship faster because of you.You are a trusted sparring partner for product and the team when we decide what to build and how.What it takesYou're strong with Postgres. Schema design comes naturally, you can read a query plan, and you know when the ORM is lying to you. Geospatial experience is a bonus, not a requirement.You're fluent in typed backend TypeScript. We work in NestJS and GraphQL every day; if your experience is in a comparable stack, that's fine, you'll pick it up fast.You've built real queue-based processing. You designed workers, dealt with retries and partial failures, orchestrated multi-step workflows.You've designed or worked with authorization for a multi-tenant product and know where it might get hairy.You'd rather have one integration test that hits a real database schema than ten unit tests mocking everything. You write the test that catches the broken migration.You treat production as a debuggable system. You can navigate dashboards and traces to figure out why something is slow, and you don't treat infrastructure as someone else's problem.You communicate clearly - with engineers, product and, when needed, directly with customers.You speak German at C1 level or better and English fluently. Our customers are German banks and asset managers, and you will talk to them.Bonus:AWS (S3, SES, ECS, RDS, …) and IaC.LLMs in production, especially document or data extraction and making it reliable for actual user workflows.Data pipeline work: staged, reproducible processing, dataset versioning.Mentoring or leading engineers, or wanting to grow into it.Debugging tooling and build issues, not just application code. Our toolchain moves fast and is occasionally non-standard.Why Predium?Stage: ~40 people, well-funded, on the way to defining the category. Early enough that a lot still needs to be built. Yes, it's messy sometimes - that's the whole point. If you're looking for a job with a finished playbook, this isn't the right fit.Impact: You're not cog #100 in some company. What you build here runs in production and is what customers rely on every day. Your contribution shows up directly, in revenue and in the product.Ownership: We don't manage your time, we measure your results. You get responsibility and freedom - and the expectation that you'll use both.Compensation: Competitive salary, bonus, and equity. title: Senior Software Engineer - Platform & Infrastructure (f/m/d)
description_clean: The product you will work onThe HOLOPLOT Matrix Array is a new type of sound system built around precise, software-defined control of sound in three dimensions - grounded in physics and implemented through a combination of custom hardware and purpose-built software. HOLOPLOT deployed Matrix Arrays in various venues, including the Sphere in Las Vegas - the world’s most advanced entertainment venue and, notably, home to the world’s largest audio installation in entertainment. Audio processing in HOLOPLOT systems is distributed: every loudspeaker runs embedded Linux, and hundreds of them have to be configured, coordinated, monitored, and updated as one system. This is enabled by multiple open source and in-house developed services running on an on-premises Kubernetes cluster. AWS-hosted services connect venues to remote monitoring, telemetry, and configuration. Many venues are air-gapped or only intermittently connected for remote servicing, and that constraint shapes most of the design decisions in the platform.The ideal candidate isWe are looking for a Senior Software Engineer who builds the platform our sound systems run on, and who takes responsibility for how it behaves in production.This is a software engineering role first. You will spend your time writing software, either with your own team or embedded with one of the other HOLOPLOT teams: services, controllers, agents, and tooling that provision, configure, observe, and update our systems. Our infrastructure is defined as code and evolves through the same review and release process as the rest of our software. You design the operational side, you build it, and you are on call when it misbehaves in the field.Your role and responsibilitiesYou will join the team that owns the platform underneath our installations and connected services, working alongside backend, embedded, and frontend engineers who are organized in cross-functional product teams.Build the platformArchitect and implement services to provision, configure, and manage server fleets across AWS and local clusters.Create control-plane logic for venue systems to ensure consistency, health monitoring, rollout management, and recovery, even during uplink disruptions.Establish end-to-end provisioning workflows for embedded Linux hardware, spanning from initial manufacturing to customer deployment.Enhance update processes to streamline software deployments for active customer installations.Develop APIs and developer tooling that empower engineering teams to independently deploy, observe, and troubleshoot their services.Embed telemetry capabilities into the platform to facilitate remote diagnosis of venue system behavior.Run what you buildOwn the AWS infrastructure behind our connected services: remote access, access control, telemetry ingestion, remote backup, secret management, and monitoring. All of it is infrastructure as code.Operate and evolve the on-premises Kubernetes footprint at venues, including air-gapped and intermittently connected installations.Monitor large environments, investigate problems across the software/hardware boundary, and turn each incident into a fix in the code.Be part of a compensated on-call rotationSet the technical directionAdvise and collaborate with product teams on building distributed systems that are scalable, secure, and observable, and review their designs with production reality in mind.Research and introduce tools and technologies where they measurably improve how we build and operate.Contribute back to the open-source projects we depend on, through issues and fixes.What you need to succeed in this roleSeveral years of professional software engineering experience, most of it spent designing and shipping production systems.Fluency in software engineering as a craft: concurrency, error handling, testing, and designing APIs that other teams build on.Working knowledge of the Kubernetes control plane and the operator/controller pattern, including how clusters behave when they are unhealthy.Hands-on experience with AWS, and a firm belief in infrastructure as code. Terraform and Ansible are what we use today.Comfort across several languages, and the ability to pick up a new one when the problem calls for it. Our platform work is mostly Go and Python, with Rust and C++ elsewhere in the stack.Experience building distributed systems, and a clear understanding of how they fail: partitions, partial rollouts, clock skew, retries, and reconciliation.A good sense for software architecture and maintainability, and the habit of writing code that colleagues can pick up and change.A strong command of Linux, scripting, and automation.Experience instrumenting software for telemetry and using it to answer real questions about running systems.Good judgment about what to automate and what to leave alone.Strong communication skills in English. You can explain a design or a failure clearly to engineers, product stakeholders, and non-specialists.Willingness to take part in compensated on-call and weekend work when installations need it.A can-do mentality, an eye for detail, and the courage to take on problems outside your comfort zone.Experience in using AI for engineering.Nice to havesExperience with NATS, Prometheus/Thanos, or PostgreSQL in production.Experience with air-gapped or intermittently connected installations.Experience running Kubernetes in production, not only deploying to it.Experience with embedded Linux, device fleet management, or IoT security.Networking depth: multicast at scale, WireGuard, BGP, IPv6.Experience in the audio, broadcast, or live events industry.Contributions to open-source infrastructure projectsWe offer youAt HOLOPLOT we work in a flexible hybrid setup with trust-based working hours, giving you the freedom to organise your day in a way that supports focus, deep work and balance. Pay is competitive and fair, and we offer perks and benefits such as subsidised public transport, lunch allowances, Urban Sports and a company pension scheme.You’ll join an international, open-minded team across software, hardware, product and research, in an environment with plenty of autonomy and ownership. You’ll work on cutting-edge audio technology, turn complex requirements into working solutions and contribute to global projects, with support for your growth through individual development plans, mentoring and coaching.Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Optimization and Forecast Engineer - Energy Systems (f/m/d)
description_clean:
About FION
European industry is losing competitiveness because electricity here is more expensive and more volatile than in the US or China. The reason: renewables fluctuate strongly, factories consume constantly.
We close that gap. FION plans and installs the right battery system for an industrial site and runs it with AI in real time against tariffs and markets. The software that dimensions, controls and monitors those systems is our own, and it runs end to end: ML and optimization in the cloud, data streaming and control, and the edge device at the customer site. The result for the customer: significantly lower energy costs and measurable CO2 savings. We earn trust by delivering systems and operating them transparently.
We already work with more than 20 factories across industries such as plastics, automotive and food processing, and we are backed by early-stage investors.
We're looking for an engineer with deep experience in time-series forecasting and mathematical optimization to join us as an early hire. You'll work on the forecasting and optimization core of our platform: the models that forecast industrial electricity consumption and PV generation, and the optimization that decides how each battery operates and trades against tariffs and markets within physical and grid constraints. This is a startup role: you should be comfortable switching between strategic thinking and hands-on work.
You'll work directly with the CTO, one of the co-founders.
Tasks
Forecasting models Develop and improve time-series forecasting models for industrial electricity consumption, PV generation, and other energy-relevant signals, and extend them with probabilistic outputs. Evaluate forecast quality on noisy, incomplete, and non-stationary industrial data, including its actual operational and economic impact.
Battery dispatch optimization Develop and improve the optimization models that schedule battery dispatch across peak shaving, self-consumption, spot market trading and flexibility marketing, while adhering to physical and grid constraints. Design how forecasts, uncertainty measures, physical constraints, and system states are used in downstream optimization workflows.
Validation, simulation and monitoring Build and improve simulation, replay, benchmarking, and validation workflows to test model behavior before and alongside deployment in live systems. Build and use tools and processes to monitor and assess the quality of operational forecasting and optimization models.
Production integration Design, write, test, and deploy production-grade code for mission-critical forecasting and optimization products. Improve robustness through plausibility checks, fallback behavior, re-forecasting, and handling of low-confidence or missing data. Collaborate closely with software engineers to integrate models into our core platform and edge devices.
Requirements
You bring:
- 5+ years of professional software engineering experience
- Strong applied experience in time-series and probabilistic forecasting: forecast calibration, uncertainty evaluation, backtesting, and model validation
- Strong understanding of mathematical optimization, especially LP/MILP, and the ability to model real-world systems through objectives, constraints, and operational rules
- Strong Python skills with the scientific and machine learning tool stack (pandas, NumPy, SciPy, scikit-learn, PyTorch)
- Experience developing, releasing, and tracking the performance of forecasting or optimization models in a commercial software setting
- An ownership mindset - you want to shape the platform, not just implement tickets
Even better if you have:
- Energy domain knowledge - you understand power, energy, phases, and how the grid works
- Understanding of European electricity markets, flexibility services, and grid operation
- BESS-specific experience: familiarity with BESS architectures, components, and operation, and direct experience with energy management algorithms for battery systems
- Experience with open-source and commercial MILP solvers (e.g. Pyomo, OR-Tools)
- Experience with optimization techniques such as stochastic or robust optimization
- Experience building forecasting and machine learning products in the cloud (e.g. AWS, GCP, Azure)
- Experience using Large Language Models to accelerate software development and reliably add new capabilities to real products
- German language skills (our customers and partners are German)
Benefits
Ownership, not tickets This isn't a role where the models are decided and you fill in the blanks. The forecasting and dispatch optimization stack is greenfield - nothing exists yet, and you'll design and build it from the ground up. At larger energy companies, this scope is split across multiple teams. Here, you own it all.
Real impact, fast Your code runs physical batteries that save real factories real money. You'll see results on a Grafana dashboard the same week you deploy.
Founding trajectory As FION grows, you grow with it - from hands-on builder to platform lead to head of forecasting and optimization. What takes 5 years at a large company, you'll have from day one.

- you participate in the company's success
- Berlin hybrid (remote from within Germany possible for the right person)

title: Operations Intern for AVD (Altersvorsorgedepot) (f/m/d)
description_clean: At Upvest, we are on a mission to make investing as easy as spending money. Upvest empowers businesses to offer a wide range of investment products and the best experience in the field of capital market investment and retirement planning. Upvest’s Investment API is easy to integrate so that fintechs and financial institutions can save resources and fully focus on their core business.We are proud to partner with Europe’s leading Fintechs and financial institutions such as DKB, Revolut, N26 and Raisin. Founded in 2017 by Martin Kassing, Upvest now brings together over 270 talented professionals from more than 70 nationalities. Upvest is backed by €280M in total funding from world-class investors, including BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures, and Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital, and Motive. Our latest €105M funding round in March 2026 - led by Sapphire and Tencent - serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experience.About the role:Germany's private pension system is being rebuilt from the ground up. From 1 January 2027, the Altersvorsorgedepot (AVD) replaces the Riester-Rente as the country's state-subsidised private pension and Upvest is building the operational infrastructure that lets fintechs and banks offer it to millions of savers.Join us as an AVD Operations Intern and you'll be there before Day 1: helping design the processes, then running them once they go live. This is a rare chance to see a regulated financial product being built from a blank page, rather than inheriting one that already works.What you’ll do:Support day-to-day AVD operations: Help run the core processes that keep the product working, e.g. contract registration with the ZfA (Zentrale Zulagenstelle für Altersvermögen), contribution management, the annual bonus application (AZ01), and payment reconciliation. You'll learn how a state-subsidised pension product actually functions behind the interface.Help build the playbooks: As we prepare for launch, we're writing the processes from scratch. You'll help document workflows, build step-by-step guides and error catalogues, and keep them current as the rules and our systems evolve; the foundations the team will scale on.Support error handling and reconciliation: Work through recurring error cases from the ZfA, check that payments and records match, and help spot the patterns behind repeat issues so they can be fixed at the root rather than one at a time.Support our client teams: Our partners' support teams field questions from their end-users about subsidies, transfers and payouts. You'll help prepare clear, accurate answers and learn to translate dense regulation into language a customer can act on.Spot what should be better: You'll see every manual workaround first-hand. We want your view on what's slow, error-prone, or worth automating; and you'll have the room to say so.What you bring:You are fluent in German (C1 or above) and comfortable working in English. This one is a hard requirement rather than a nice-to-have: the regulation, the correspondence with the ZfA, and most of the documentation you'll work with day to day are all in German.You're a student in Business, Economics, Finance, Law, or a related field — or on a gap year between degrees.You're structured and genuinely precise. In this role, small details carry real consequences for someone's pension, and you're the kind of person who notices when a number doesn't add up.You're curious about rules rather than put off by them. You're willing to read the actual regulation to understand why a process works the way it does.You're comfortable with ambiguity. The product is brand new, so some answers don't exist yet; you'll ask good questions instead of waiting for perfect instructions.You're confident with spreadsheets. Any prior exposure to financial services, operations or a regulated environment is a bonus, but not required.You're available for a minimum of 4 months (6 preferred) and based in Berlin.How we Upvest in you:Impact-driven work: We’re building the infrastructure that will power the future of investing in Europe. It’s complex, ambitious, and meaningful. You’ll work with modern technologies and create something entirely new. No legacy systems, no limits.Team celebrations: Participate in company-wide events, such as UpFest, dinners, offsites and our Holiday party, to connect with colleagues and celebrate our achievements.Inclusion: We’re committed to a culture where everyone belongs and thrives. Our Employee Resources Groups foster inclusion and connection, like Upfem for our female Upvengers, or UpVergent supporting neurodivergent Upvengers and allies.Our Values:Make it easy for others. We simplify the complex and act with the best intentions.Own the outcome. We are proactive, fast and confident to get the job done, valuing progress over perfection.Rise to the challenge. We aim high and push the boundaries. We stay curious, learn and celebrate our wins together.Tell the story. We start with the Why to align on purpose. We are transparent and share knowledge to empower and inspire others.Upvest is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Frontend Engineer - React
description_clean:
ResearchGate is the professional network for scientists and researchers. From climate change and emerging diseases to food security and the responsible development of AI, the challenges facing our world are complex. Still, we’re optimistic about the power of millions of scientists working together to tackle them. We provide scientists with the help and support they need by connecting them to the world’s most active scientific community.
We've built a platform that gives the world's scientists the tools and services they need to connect, collaborate, and advance their research. Over 25 million members from 193 countries use ResearchGate to share, discover, and discuss research.
Objective of the role
We're looking for an enthusiastic frontend engineer with the skills and ability to turn great ideas into reality. You should have an in-depth understanding of current web technologies and front-end development, and be passionate about creating a great user experience. Your input will help us grow and maintain our React front-end.
Join a team that encourages you to explore, learn, and go beyond, while seeing your work lead to actionable results. Put your creative problem-solving and development skills into action and make a positive impact on science and society. This is a full-time position based in Germany.
The team 
You will be an integral part of the product team dedicated to enhancing ResearchGate's publisher-facing product. This role involves designing, constructing, and refining the platform to further our mission of facilitating global scientific connections and ensuring open access to research. At present, our team is working on making ResearchGate a great platform for publishers to connect with existing and future authors.
Your immediate colleagues will consist of JavaScript and PHP engineers, an Engineering Manager, a Product Manager, a UX Designer, and a UX Writer. Our team places great value on our collaborative and communicative work culture and we eagerly anticipate integrating a new Engineer into this environment.
Responsibilites 


Create web interfaces using TypeScript and React for new products and features.


Seamlessly integrate our front-end with our back-end world using GraphQL and PHP.


Maintain and improve existing features and related infrastructure.


Collaborate with Product Managers, Designers, and Software Engineers to deliver compelling publisher-facing products.


Requirements


5+ years frontend web development experience in TypeScript (React), CSS


Demonstrated ability to create code that is easily comprehensible, maintainable, and testable.


Eagerness to acquire new skills, delve into different technologies and programming languages, and a willingness to acknowledge areas where expertise may be lacking.


Approach problem-solving thoughtfully, embracing curiosity and maintaining an open-minded perspective.


You are comfortable incorporating AI-assisted development tools into your daily workflow and exercise strong engineering judgment when evaluating and refining their output.


Knowledge of GraphQL.


It would be a plus if you already had knowledge of relational and document-based databases (we use MongoDB and Postgres).


What we're looking for 


You take responsibility over your own solutions and continuously improve them.


You engage in proactive and efficient communication within our distributed work environment.


You focus on building a great product.


You excel at designing and creating coherent, user-centric interfaces that display complex information.



The interview process


We start with a short call with HR or an Engineering Manager to align on the details of the job inquiry.


There will be a longer discussion about your technical and professional experience and expectations with an Engineering Manager and another colleague.


We’ll facilitate a technical interview with one or two engineers with some pair programming and technical discussion.


You'll have a conversation with our VP of Product, Mark, and our VP of Engineering, Frank, to learn more about our product and engineering organization and discuss how your experience aligns with our goals.


Last but not least, you will meet with our CEO, Ijad, and our VP of Finance & People team, Jess.

Und, du bist an vielfältigen Projekten in einem kollegialen Arbeitsumfeld interessiert? Dann schau dir MaibornWolff einmal näher an! Wir bei MaibornWolff sind ein inhabergeführtes, mittelständisches IT-Beratungsunternehmen mit über 30 Jahren Expertise. Mit rund 800 Tech-begeisterten Menschen beraten wir unsere Kunden bei ihren Digitalisierungsstrategien und entwickeln moderne, individuelle Softwarelösungen. 2024 sind wir in die Lünendonk-Liste der „führenden mittelständischen IT-Beratungen in Deutschland" aufgestiegen, worauf wir sehr stolz sind.In unserer Delivery-Enabler Gilde arbeiten aktuell elf Scrum Master:innen, Agile Coaches und Delivery Enabler an mehreren Standorten in Deutschland. Unsere Mission: Delivery Enablement als starke, zukunftsfähige Rolle etablieren und Projekt-Teams auch im KI-Wandel wirksam unterstützen. Wir teilen Wissen, gestalten unsere Rolle gemeinsam weiter und bringen unterschiedliche Stärken ein. Unsere Projekte reichen von einzelnen Entwicklungsteams bis hin zu internationalen Programmen in Branchen wie Automotive, Energie und Public Sector.Hier kommst du ins Spiel: Als Delivery Enabler übernimmst du Verantwortung für eine Rolle im Umbruch, führst interdisziplinäre Teams durch den KI-Wandel und trägst maßgeblich dazu bei, Delivery Enablement zu einer starken, zukunftsfähigen Funktion weiterzuentwickeln.Deine AufgabenTeams stärken: Du arbeitest eng mit deinen Entwicklungsteams zusammen: Du beseitigst Hindernisse, entwickelst konstruktive Arbeitsweisen weiter und förderst so effektive Teamstrukturen.Stakeholder steuern: Du bringst die unterschiedlichen Interessen von Team, Kunde und MaibornWolff aktiv zusammen und sorgst so für einen klaren, effizienten Entscheidungs- und Kommunikationsfluss.Delivery absichern: Anhand konkreter Kennzahlen machst du Wirkung und Wertbeitrag deiner Rolle sichtbar. Du schaffst ein gemeinsames Verständnis von Zielen und Erwartungen, beseitigst Hindernisse und adressierst mögliche Risiken frühzeitig.KI-Agenten integrieren: Du befähigst dein Team zur optimalen Einbindung von KI-Agenten und Tools und hast die damit verbundenen Prozess- und Kommunikationsverschiebungen im Blick. Du begleitest Teams und Kunden souverän durch KI-bedingte Change Prozesse.Bereich mitgestalten: Gemeinsam mit deiner Delivery Enabler-Gilde entwickelst du unser Rollenverständnis weiter, teilst dein Wissen und treibst relevante Themen voran. Wenn du möchtest, engagierst du dich zusätzlich als Mentor:in in der Mitarbeitendenentwicklung oder in anderen internen Aufgaben.Dein ProfilAusbildung: Du hast idealerweise ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Wirtschaft oder IT - entscheidend ist für uns jedoch deine reale Projekterfahrung.Praxiserfahrung: Du bringst mindestens 3-5 Jahre relevante Projekterfahrung als Scrum Master, Agile Coach oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle innerhalb der Softwareentwicklung mit. Du kennst sowohl die Arbeit auf Teamebene als auch die Koordination über mehrere Teams hinweg, idealerweise ergänzt durch Erfahrung in interkulturellen Kontexten.Methodenkompetenz: Du beherrschst agile Frameworks wie Scrum oder Kanban und bestenfalls auch Skalierungsmodelle wie SAFe, Nexus oder LeSS. Zudem bist du stark in Stakeholder-Management, Facilitation & Workshop-Design sowie in agilen Metriken und Forecasting. Vielleicht hast du sogar bereits Erfahrungen mit OKRs, Flight Levels oder im Value Stream Mapping gesammelt. Tools: Du nutzt KI-Anwendungen routiniert und zielgerichtet für deine eigene Arbeitseffizienz. Zudem hast du durch deine Projektarbeit ein klares Verständnis zu Wirkweise und möglichen Fallstricken von KI in der Softwareentwicklung gewonnen.Reisebereitschaft:  Du bist bereit, bei Bedarf bis zu zwei Tage pro Woche zu reisen – für Workshops, Team-Events oder den direkten Austausch mit Team und Kunden vor Ort.Sprachkenntnisse: Du sprichst verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und sehr gutes Englisch.Deine BenefitsNew Work. Home Office & Office, flexible Arbeitszeiten, Teilzeitmodelle, Arbeitszeitkonto, SabbaticalWeiterbildung. 1,5 Bruttomonatsgehälter stehen jährlich bereit, damit du deinen Horizont erweitern kannst.Mitarbeiterevents. Ob Firmenseminare im Sommer oder Weihnachtsfeiern, wir feiern die kleinen und großen Anlässe.Betriebliche Leistungen. Zuzahlung zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge, Mobilitätsbudget und Sport-Angebot.Forschung & Entwicklung. Stecke deine Nase bewusst auch in andere Themen rein.Moderne Hard- und Software. iPhone, MacBook, Lenovo-Notebook, moderne Büroausstattung.Du hast Fragen?Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung! improvements.You communicate clearly in English, and bring professional working proficiency in German to navigate regulatory documents and stakeholder communication in a German market context.You are
